rules.name: Couverture des sources
rules.description: État des 42 sources lues par les règles « Adresse IP » (39 tables). Une source est une table, ou une partie d'une table journalisée : par exemple SecurityEvent · accès aux fichiers (4656, 4660, 4663, 4670). Pour chacune : table présente ou non, alimentée sur la fenêtre, événements réellement collectés (stratégie d'audit, règle de collecte), colonnes utilisées manquantes, et si une autre source de la même famille compense. À lancer en premier sur un nouvel environnement : une source absente ne produit aucune erreur, seulement des résultats vides.

reading.decisive: Ligne « Non couvert » : aucune source de la famille n'est alimentée, les règles citées ne peuvent rien montrer de ce type d'événement.
reading.context: Ligne « Événements non collectés » : la table est alimentée mais pas ces EventID (audit non activé, SACL absente, règle de collecte trop restreinte). « Colonnes manquantes » : le schéma diffère, la branche correspondante est ignorée.
reading.noise: Source absente mais « Compensé par » : une source équivalente fournit les mêmes événements.

rules.name: Activité de l'IP par jour
rules.description: Nombre d'événements contenant l'IP par jour et par table (Entra ID utilisateurs et applications, Microsoft Graph, Windows, Defender, Microsoft 365, Azure, pare-feu et proxy, messagerie, Linux). Montre si l'IP est nouvelle, dormante ou habituelle. Une table absente n'apparaît pas : voir IP-S0 pour savoir lesquelles sont alimentées.

reading.decisive: Première apparition dans les dernières 24 heures après plusieurs jours d'absence.
reading.context: Changement brutal de volume ou apparition dans une nouvelle table (par exemple Azure après Entra ID).
reading.noise: IP de proxy, de NAT ou de VPN d'entreprise présentes tous les jours dans toutes les tables.

let EndTimestamp = T0 + After;

// Événements de sécurité Windows normalisés, quelle que soit la table d'ingestion :
// Pour les SecurityEvent, on reparse les champs depuis le EventData XML si il y a des bugs, avec une regex (ajouté au moment du build)
// Paramètres : start, end (fenêtre), ids (liste d'EventID, vide = tous), term (pré-filtre texte, vide = aucun ;
// recherché dans le XML brut et dans les colonnes de compte, de machine, d'IP et de processus).
// Colonnes ajoutées pour ne pas confondre la machine qui journalise avec la machine utilisée :
// - TargetHost : machine réellement visée. 4769 : la machine du service demandé (ServiceName « FS01$ ») ; 4648 : TargetServerName ;
//   4768, 4771, 4776 : vide (simple validation d'identifiants, la cible n'est pas connue) ; sinon : Computer.
// - AuthAuthority : machine qui a validé les identifiants (DC, ou la machine elle-même pour un compte local en NTLM) pour
//   4768, 4769, 4771 et 4776 ; vide sinon.
// - SourceHost : poste d'origine déclaré (WorkstationName), à défaut l'IP source.
// - ObjectAccess : droits demandés sur un fichier, une clé ou un partage (lecture, écriture, suppression, permissions,
//   exécution) pour 4656, 4657, 4660, 4663, 4670, 5140 et 5145 (audit « Système de fichiers », « Registre », « Partage de
//   fichiers détaillé » : rien n'est produit sans stratégie d'audit et, pour les fichiers et le registre, sans SACL).
// Fragment propre à Sentinel : retiré de la variante Defender (les règles l'appellent dans des blocs @sentinel-only).
// @requires: win_names
// @sentinel-only:begin
let _WinSecurity = (start:datetime, end:datetime, ids:dynamic, term:string) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        SecurityEvent
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where array_length(ids) == 0 or EventID in (ids)
        | where isempty(term) or EventData has term or Computer has term or IpAddress has term or TargetUserName has term
            or SubjectUserName has term or WorkstationName has term or NewProcessName has term or ParentProcessName has term
            or TargetServerName has term
        | extend _x = tostring(EventData)
        | extend
            SubjectUserSid = coalesce(SubjectUserSid, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectUserSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectUserName = coalesce(SubjectUserName, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectUserName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectDomainName = coalesce(SubjectDomainName, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectDomainName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectLogonId = coalesce(SubjectLogonId, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectLogonId">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetUserSid = coalesce(TargetUserSid, TargetSid, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetUserSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetUserName = coalesce(TargetUserName, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetUserName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetDomainName = coalesce(TargetDomainName, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetDomainName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetLogonId = coalesce(TargetLogonId, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetLogonId">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            LogonType = coalesce(tostring(LogonType), extract(@'<Data Name="LogonType">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            LogonProcessName = coalesce(LogonProcessName, extract(@'<Data Name="LogonProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            AuthenticationPackageName = coalesce(AuthenticationPackageName, PackageName, extract(@'<Data Name="AuthenticationPackageName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="PackageName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            WorkstationName = coalesce(WorkstationName, Workstation, extract(@'<Data Name="WorkstationName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="Workstation">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            IpAddress = coalesce(IpAddress, ClientAddress, extract(@'<Data Name="IpAddress">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="ClientAddress">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            IpPort = coalesce(IpPort, extract(@'<Data Name="IpPort">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="ClientPort">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ProcessName = coalesce(ProcessName, extract(@'<Data Name="ProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ElevatedToken = coalesce(ElevatedToken, extract(@'<Data Name="ElevatedToken">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            Status = coalesce(Status, extract(@'<Data Name="Status">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubStatus = coalesce(SubStatus, extract(@'<Data Name="SubStatus">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ServiceName = coalesce(ServiceName, extract(@'<Data Name="ServiceName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TicketEncryptionType = extract(@'<Data Name="TicketEncryptionType">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            TicketOptions = extract(@'<Data Name="TicketOptions">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            TargetServerName = coalesce(TargetServerName, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetServerName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            NewProcessName = coalesce(NewProcessName, extract(@'<Data Name="NewProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ParentProcessName = coalesce(ParentProcessName, extract(@'<Data Name="ParentProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            CommandLine = coalesce(CommandLine, extract(@'<Data Name="CommandLine">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TaskName = extract(@'<Data Name="TaskName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            TaskContent = coalesce(extract(@'<Data Name="TaskContent">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="TaskContentNew">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            MemberName = coalesce(MemberName, extract(@'<Data Name="MemberName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            MemberSid = coalesce(MemberSid, extract(@'<Data Name="MemberSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ServiceFileName = coalesce(ServiceFileName, extract(@'<Data Name="ServiceFileName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="ImagePath">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),

            City = tostring(_loc.city), AutonomousSystemNumber, ClientAppUsed, UserAgent, DeviceName = tostring(_dev.displayName),
            DeviceId = tostring(_dev.deviceId), OperatingSystem = tostring(_dev.operatingSystem), Browser = tostring(_dev.browser),
            IsManaged = tostring(_dev.isManaged), IsCompliant = tostring(_dev.isCompliant), TrustType = tostring(_dev.trustType),
            ConditionalAccessStatus, AuthenticationRequirement, RiskLevelDuringSignIn, SessionId, CorrelationId
    ),
    (
        AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where isempty(ip) or IPAddress == ip
        | where isempty(upn) or UserPrincipalName =~ upn
        | extend _dev = parse_json(DeviceDetail), _loc = parse_json(LocationDetails), _st = parse_json(Status)
        | project TimeGenerated, SourceTable = "AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs", SignInType = "NonInteractive", UserPrincipalName, UserId,
            AppDisplayName, AppId, ResourceDisplayName, ResultType, ResultDescription, FailureReason = tostring(_st.failureReason),
            IPAddress, Location, City = tostring(_loc.city), AutonomousSystemNumber, ClientAppUsed, UserAgent,
            DeviceName = tostring(_dev.displayName), DeviceId = tostring(_dev.deviceId), OperatingSystem = tostring(_dev.operatingSystem),
            Browser = tostring(_dev.browser), IsManaged = tostring(_dev.isManaged), IsCompliant = tostring(_dev.isCompliant),
            TrustType = tostring(_dev.trustType), ConditionalAccessStatus, AuthenticationRequirement, RiskLevelDuringSignIn, SessionId, CorrelationId
    ),
    (
        EntraIdSignInEvents
        | where Timestamp between (start .. end)
        | extend SignInType = iff(LogonType contains "noninteractive", "NonInteractive", "Interactive")
        | where (SignInType == "Interactive" and not(_HasInteractive)) or (SignInType == "NonInteractive" and not(_HasNonInteractive))
        | where isempty(ip) or IPAddress == ip
        | where isempty(upn) or AccountUpn =~ upn
        | project TimeGenerated = Timestamp, SourceTable = "EntraIdSignInEvents", SignInType, UserPrincipalName = AccountUpn,
            UserId = AccountObjectId, AppDisplayName = Application, AppId = ApplicationId, ResourceDisplayName,
            ResultType = tostring(ErrorCode), ResultDescription = "", FailureReason = "", IPAddress, Location = Country, City,
            AutonomousSystemNumber = "", ClientAppUsed, UserAgent, DeviceName, DeviceId = EntraIdDeviceId, OperatingSystem = OSPlatform,
            Browser, IsManaged = tostring(IsManaged == 1), IsCompliant = tostring(IsCompliant == 1), TrustType = DeviceTrustType,
            ConditionalAccessStatus = case(ConditionalAccessStatus == 0, "success", ConditionalAccessStatus == 1, "failure",
                ConditionalAccessStatus == 2, "notApplied", tostring(ConditionalAccessStatus)),
            AuthenticationRequirement,
            RiskLevelDuringSignIn = case(RiskLevelDuringSignIn == 100, "high", RiskLevelDuringSignIn == 50, "medium",
                RiskLevelDuringSignIn == 10, "low", RiskLevelDuringSignIn == 0, "none", tostring(RiskLevelDuringSignIn)),
            SessionId, CorrelationId
    )
    | extend Succeeded = ResultType == "0"
};
// Connexions Entra ID des applications (service principals) et des identités managées, normalisées :
// - Sentinel : AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs et AADManagedIdentitySignInLogs ;
// - Defender XDR : EntraIdSpnSignInEvents (IsManagedIdentity distingue les deux), lue seulement pour le type que les tables
//   Sentinel ne fournissent pas sur la période (pas de doublon dans le portail unifié).
// Paramètres : start, end, app (AppId, ServicePrincipalId ou nom ; vide = toutes), ip (vide = toutes).
let _SpnSignins = (start:datetime, end:datetime, app:string, ip:string) {
    let _HasSpn = toscalar(union isfuzzy=true
        (AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs | where TimeGenerated between ((start - 1d) .. end) | take 1 | project Present = 1),
        (print Present = 0)
        | summarize max(Present)) == 1;
    let _HasMi = toscalar(union isfuzzy=true
        (AADManagedIdentitySignInLogs | where TimeGenerated between ((start - 1d) .. end) | take 1 | project Present = 1),
        (print Present = 0)
        | summarize max(Present)) == 1;
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where isempty(app) or AppId == app or ServicePrincipalId == app or ServicePrincipalName =~ app
        | where isempty(ip) or IPAddress == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, SourceTable = "AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs", SignInType = "Service principal", ServicePrincipalName,
            ServicePrincipalId, AppId, ResourceDisplayName, ResultType, IPAddress, Location, Credential = ClientCredentialType,
            AppOwnerTenantId, HomeTenantId = AADTenantId
    ),
    (
        AADManagedIdentitySignInLogs
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where isempty(app) or AppId == app or ServicePrincipalId == app or ServicePrincipalName =~ app
        | where isempty(ip) or IPAddress == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, SourceTable = "AADManagedIdentitySignInLogs", SignInType = "Identité managée", ServicePrincipalName,
            ServicePrincipalId, AppId, ResourceDisplayName, ResultType, IPAddress, Location, Credential = "Identité managée",
            AppOwnerTenantId, HomeTenantId = TenantId
    ),
    (
        EntraIdSpnSignInEvents
        | where Timestamp between (start .. end)
        | extend SignInType = iff(IsManagedIdentity, "Identité managée", "Service principal")
        | where (SignInType == "Service principal" and not(_HasSpn)) or (SignInType == "Identité managée" and not(_HasMi))
        | where isempty(app) or ApplicationId == app or ServicePrincipalId == app or ServicePrincipalName =~ app or Application =~ app
        | where isempty(ip) or IPAddress == ip
        | project TimeGenerated = Timestamp, SourceTable = "EntraIdSpnSignInEvents", SignInType, ServicePrincipalName = coalesce(ServicePrincipalName, Application),
            ServicePrincipalId, AppId = ApplicationId, ResourceDisplayName, ResultType = tostring(ErrorCode), IPAddress, Location = Country,
            Credential = iff(IsManagedIdentity, "Identité managée", iff(IsConfidentialClient, "Client confidentiel", "Client public")),
            AppOwnerTenantId = "", HomeTenantId = ResourceTenantId
    )
    | extend Succeeded = ResultType == "0"
    // Origine de l'application : éditeur Microsoft, application du tenant, ou application d'un autre tenant (multi-tenant tierce)
    | extend AppOrigin = case(AppOwnerTenantId in ("f8cdef31-a31e-4b4a-93e4-5f571e91255a", "72f988bf-86f1-41af-91ab-2d7cd011db47"), "Microsoft (first-party)",
        SignInType == "Identité managée", "Identité managée du tenant",
        isempty(AppOwnerTenantId), "",
        AppOwnerTenantId == HomeTenantId, "Application du tenant",
        "Application d'un autre tenant")
};
// Toutes les sources de journaux où apparaît une adresse IP, ramenées à des colonnes communes :
// TimeGenerated, Source, EventType (EventID, ActionType ou opération), Host, AuthBy, Account, Detail.
// - Host : machine concernée par l'événement (la cible quand l'IP est la source, la machine de l'IP quand elle est la cible),
//   jamais le contrôleur de domaine qui a seulement validé des identifiants.
// - AuthBy : contrôleur de domaine (ou machine locale) qui a validé les identifiants (4768, 4769, 4771, 4776, Defender for Identity).
// Sources : Entra ID (utilisateurs et applications), audit Entra ID, Microsoft Graph, Windows, Defender for Endpoint et
// Defender for Identity, Sysmon 3, accès aux partages (5140, 5145), Microsoft 365, Azure, pare-feu et proxy (CEF, Azure
// Firewall, ASIM), messagerie, Linux (Syslog).
// @requires: win_security, sysmon, signins, spn_signins
let _IpEvents = (start:datetime, end:datetime, ip:string) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        _Signins(start, end, ip, "")
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = strcat("Entra ID (", SignInType, ")"), EventType = iff(Succeeded, "Connexion réussie", strcat("Échec ", ResultType)),
            Host = DeviceName, AuthBy = "", Account = tolower(UserPrincipalName), Detail = AppDisplayName
    ),
    (
        _SpnSignins(start, end, "", ip)
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = strcat("Entra ID (", SignInType, ")"), EventType = iff(Succeeded, "Connexion réussie", strcat("Échec ", ResultType)),
            Host = "", AuthBy = "", Account = tolower(ServicePrincipalName), Detail = ResourceDisplayName
    ),
    (
        AuditLogs
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress) == ip or tostring(InitiatedBy.app.ipAddress) == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "AuditLogs", EventType = OperationName, Host = "", AuthBy = "",
            Account = tolower(coalesce(tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName), tostring(InitiatedBy.app.displayName))),
            Detail = tostring(TargetResources[0].displayName)
    ),
    (
        MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where IPAddress == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs", EventType = strcat(RequestMethod, " ", tostring(ResponseStatusCode)),
            Host = "", AuthBy = "", Account = coalesce(UserId, ServicePrincipalId),
            Detail = replace_regex(tostring(parse_url(RequestUri).Path), @"[0-9a-fA-F-]{36}", "{id}")
    ),
    (
        _WinSecurity(start, end, dynamic([]), ip)
        | where IpAddress == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = SourceTable, EventType = strcat(tostring(EventID), " ", EventName),
            Host = TargetHost, AuthBy = AuthAuthority, Account = coalesce(TargetSam, SubjectSam),
            Detail = case(EventID in (5140, 5145), strcat(ShareName, " ", RelativeTargetName, " · ", ObjectAccess), LogonTypeName)
    ),
    (
        _Sysmon(start, end, dynamic([3]), ip)
        | where DestinationIp == ip or SourceIp == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "Sysmon 3", EventType = iff(Initiated == "true", "Connexion sortante", "Connexion entrante"),
            Host = Computer, AuthBy = "", Account = UserSam,
            Detail = strcat(ProcessFile, " → ", DestinationIp, ":", DestinationPort, iff(isempty(DestinationHostname), "", strcat(" (", DestinationHostname, ")")))
    ),
    (
        DeviceNetworkEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where RemoteIP == ip or LocalIP == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "DeviceNetworkEvents", EventType = ActionType, Host = DeviceName, AuthBy = "",
            Account = tolower(InitiatingProcessAccountName), Detail = strcat(InitiatingProcessFileName, " → ", RemoteIP, ":", tostring(RemotePort))
    ),
    (
        DeviceLogonEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where RemoteIP == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "DeviceLogonEvents", EventType = ActionType, Host = DeviceName, AuthBy = "",
            Account = tolower(AccountName), Detail = LogonType
    ),
    (
        IdentityLogonEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where IPAddress == ip or DestinationIPAddress == ip
        // IP source : la machine concernée est la cible (le DC de destination n'a fait que valider) ; IP destination : la machine source
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "IdentityLogonEvents", EventType = ActionType,
            Host = iff(IPAddress == ip, TargetDeviceName, DeviceName),
            AuthBy = iff(IPAddress == ip, DestinationDeviceName, ""),
            Account = tolower(coalesce(AccountUpn, AccountName)), Detail = strcat(Application, " ", Protocol)
    ),
    (
        IdentityQueryEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where IPAddress == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "IdentityQueryEvents", EventType = strcat(ActionType, " ", QueryType), Host = DeviceName,
            AuthBy = DestinationDeviceName, Account = tolower(coalesce(AccountUpn, AccountName)), Detail = strcat(Protocol, " ", QueryTarget)
    ),
    (
        IdentityDirectoryEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where IPAddress == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "IdentityDirectoryEvents", EventType = ActionType, Host = coalesce(TargetDeviceName, DeviceName),
            AuthBy = DestinationDeviceName, Account = tolower(coalesce(AccountUpn, AccountName)), Detail = strcat(Application, " ", Protocol)
    ),
    (
        ASimAuthenticationEventLogs
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where SrcIpAddr == ip or TargetIpAddr == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = strcat("ASimAuthenticationEventLogs (", EventProduct, ")"), EventType = strcat(EventType, " ", EventResult),
            Host = iff(SrcIpAddr == ip, coalesce(TargetHostname, DvcHostname), SrcHostname), AuthBy = "",
            Account = tolower(TargetUsername), Detail = strcat(LogonProtocol, " ", LogonMethod)
    ),
    (
        CloudAppEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where IPAddress == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "CloudAppEvents", EventType = ActionType, Host = "", AuthBy = "",
            Account = tolower(coalesce(tostring(RawEventData.UserId), AccountDisplayName)), Detail = Application
    ),
    (
        OfficeActivity
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where ClientIP has ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "OfficeActivity", EventType = Operation, Host = "", AuthBy = "",
            Account = tolower(UserId), Detail = OfficeWorkload
    ),
    (
        AzureActivity
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where CallerIpAddress == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "AzureActivity", EventType = OperationNameValue, Host = "", AuthBy = "",
            Account = tolower(Caller), Detail = ResourceGroup
    ),
    (
        CommonSecurityLog
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where SourceIP == ip or DestinationIP == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = strcat("CommonSecurityLog (", DeviceVendor, ")"), EventType = coalesce(DeviceAction, Activity),
            Host = iff(SourceIP == ip, DestinationHostName, SourceHostName), AuthBy = "",
            Account = tolower(coalesce(SourceUserName, DestinationUserName)), Detail = strcat(SourceIP, " → ", DestinationIP, ":", tostring(DestinationPort))
    ),
    (
        ASimNetworkSessionLogs
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where SrcIpAddr == ip or DstIpAddr == ip or SrcNatIpAddr == ip or DstNatIpAddr == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = strcat("ASimNetworkSessionLogs (", EventProduct, ")"), EventType = coalesce(DvcAction, EventResult),
            Host = iff(DstIpAddr == ip or DstNatIpAddr == ip, SrcHostname, DstHostname), AuthBy = "", Account = tolower(SrcUsername),
            Detail = strcat(SrcIpAddr, " → ", DstIpAddr, ":", tostring(DstPortNumber))
    ),
    (
        ASimWebSessionLogs
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where SrcIpAddr == ip or DstIpAddr == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = strcat("ASimWebSessionLogs (", EventProduct, ")"), EventType = coalesce(DvcAction, EventResult),
            Host = SrcHostname, AuthBy = "", Account = tolower(SrcUsername), Detail = Url
    ),
    (
        AZFWNetworkRule
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where SourceIp == ip or DestinationIp == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "AZFWNetworkRule", EventType = Action, Host = "", AuthBy = "", Account = "",
            Detail = strcat(SourceIp, " → ", DestinationIp, ":", tostring(DestinationPort), " ", Protocol)
    ),
    (
        AZFWApplicationRule
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where SourceIp == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "AZFWApplicationRule", EventType = Action, Host = "", AuthBy = "", Account = "",
            Detail = coalesce(TargetUrl, Fqdn)
    ),
    (
        EmailEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where SenderIPv4 == ip or SenderIPv6 == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "EmailEvents", EventType = DeliveryAction, Host = "", AuthBy = "",
            Account = tolower(SenderFromAddress), Detail = Subject
    ),
    (
        UrlClickEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where IPAddress == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "UrlClickEvents", EventType = ActionType, Host = "", AuthBy = "",
            Account = tolower(AccountUpn), Detail = Url
    ),
    (
        Syslog
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where SyslogMessage has ip or HostIP == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = strcat("Syslog (", ProcessName, ")"), EventType = SeverityLevel, Host = Computer, AuthBy = "",
            Account = tolower(extract(@"(?:Accepted|Failed) \S+ for (?:invalid user )?(\S+) from", 1, SyslogMessage)),
            Detail = substring(SyslogMessage, 0, 300)
    )
    | extend Host = tolower(Host), AuthBy = tolower(AuthBy)
};
_IpEvents(StartTimestamp, EndTimestamp, Value)
| summarize Events = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d), Source
| render timechart

rules.name: Volume par 10 minutes, par table et par événement
rules.description: Nombre d'événements contenant l'IP par tranche de 10 minutes, ventilé par table et par type d'événement (EventID, ActionType ou opération). Montre un pic d'échecs, un balisage régulier ou une activité inhabituelle.

reading.decisive: Pic d'échecs 4625 ou ResultType 50126 concentré sur quelques minutes, suivi d'un succès.
reading.context: Intervalles réguliers entre événements réseau (balisage C2).
reading.noise: NAT d'entreprise, scanners internes et passerelles qui produisent un fond constant.

rules.query:
// [IP-S2] Volume par 10 minutes, par table et par événement — Statistics / Adresse IP
// sentinel-pivot-rules 0.2.0. Paramètres : {{VALUE}}, {{T0}}, {{BEFORE_MIN}}, {{AFTER_MIN}}
let Value = trim(@"\s", @"{{VALUE}}");
let T0 = coalesce(todatetime(@"{{T0}}"), now());
let Before = coalesce(tolong(@"{{BEFORE_MIN}}"), 1440) * 1m; // défaut : 24h
let After = coalesce(tolong(@"{{AFTER_MIN}}"), 60) * 1m; // défaut : 1h
let StartTimestamp = T0 - Before;
let EndTimestamp = T0 + After;

let _WinEventName = (id:int) {
    case(
        id == 4624, "Ouverture de session réussie",
        id == 4625, "Échec d'ouverture de session",
        id == 4634, "Fermeture de session",
        id == 4647, "Déconnexion initiée par l'utilisateur",
        id == 4648, "Ouverture avec identifiants explicites",
        id == 4656, "Handle demandé sur un objet",
        id == 4657, "Valeur de registre modifiée",
        id == 4658, "Handle fermé",
        id == 4660, "Objet supprimé",
        id == 4663, "Accès à un objet",
        id == 4670, "Permissions d'un objet modifiées",
        id == 4672, "Privilèges spéciaux attribués",
        id == 4688, "Création de processus",
        id == 4697, "Service installé",
        id == 4698, "Tâche planifiée créée",
        id == 4702, "Tâche planifiée modifiée",
        id == 4720, "Compte utilisateur créé",
        id == 4722, "Compte utilisateur activé",
        id == 4724, "Réinitialisation de mot de passe",
        id == 4728, "Membre ajouté à un groupe global de sécurité",
        id == 4732, "Membre ajouté à un groupe local de sécurité",
        id == 4740, "Compte verrouillé",
        id == 4756, "Membre ajouté à un groupe universel de sécurité",
        id == 4768, "Ticket Kerberos TGT demandé",
        id == 4769, "Ticket de service Kerberos demandé",
        id == 4771, "Échec de pré-authentification Kerberos",
        id == 4776, "Validation d'identifiants NTLM",
        id == 4778, "Session RDP reconnectée",
        id == 4779, "Session RDP déconnectée",
        id == 5140, "Accès à un partage réseau",
        id == 5145, "Contrôle d'accès à un objet de partage",
        strcat("EventID ", tostring(id)))
};
let _LogonTypeName = (t:string) {
    case(
        t == "2", "Interactive",
        t == "3", "Network",
        t == "4", "Batch",
        t == "5", "Service",
        t == "7", "Unlock",
        t == "8", "NetworkCleartext",
        t == "9", "NewCredentials",
        t == "10", "RemoteInteractive",
        t == "11", "CachedInteractive",
        t)
};
// Événements de sécurité Windows normalisés, quelle que soit la table d'ingestion :
// Pour les SecurityEvent, on reparse les champs depuis le EventData XML si il y a des bugs, avec une regex (ajouté au moment du build)
// Paramètres : start, end (fenêtre), ids (liste d'EventID, vide = tous), term (pré-filtre texte, vide = aucun ;
// recherché dans le XML brut et dans les colonnes de compte, de machine, d'IP et de processus).
// Colonnes ajoutées pour ne pas confondre la machine qui journalise avec la machine utilisée :
// - TargetHost : machine réellement visée. 4769 : la machine du service demandé (ServiceName « FS01$ ») ; 4648 : TargetServerName ;
//   4768, 4771, 4776 : vide (simple validation d'identifiants, la cible n'est pas connue) ; sinon : Computer.
// - AuthAuthority : machine qui a validé les identifiants (DC, ou la machine elle-même pour un compte local en NTLM) pour
//   4768, 4769, 4771 et 4776 ; vide sinon.
// - SourceHost : poste d'origine déclaré (WorkstationName), à défaut l'IP source.
// - ObjectAccess : droits demandés sur un fichier, une clé ou un partage (lecture, écriture, suppression, permissions,
//   exécution) pour 4656, 4657, 4660, 4663, 4670, 5140 et 5145 (audit « Système de fichiers », « Registre », « Partage de
//   fichiers détaillé » : rien n'est produit sans stratégie d'audit et, pour les fichiers et le registre, sans SACL).
// Fragment propre à Sentinel : retiré de la variante Defender (les règles l'appellent dans des blocs @sentinel-only).
// @requires: win_names
// @sentinel-only:begin
let _WinSecurity = (start:datetime, end:datetime, ids:dynamic, term:string) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        SecurityEvent
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where array_length(ids) == 0 or EventID in (ids)
        | where isempty(term) or EventData has term or Computer has term or IpAddress has term or TargetUserName has term
            or SubjectUserName has term or WorkstationName has term or NewProcessName has term or ParentProcessName has term
            or TargetServerName has term
        | extend _x = tostring(EventData)
        | extend
            SubjectUserSid = coalesce(SubjectUserSid, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectUserSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectUserName = coalesce(SubjectUserName, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectUserName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectDomainName = coalesce(SubjectDomainName, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectDomainName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectLogonId = coalesce(SubjectLogonId, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectLogonId">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetUserSid = coalesce(TargetUserSid, TargetSid, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetUserSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetUserName = coalesce(TargetUserName, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetUserName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetDomainName = coalesce(TargetDomainName, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetDomainName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetLogonId = coalesce(TargetLogonId, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetLogonId">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            LogonType = coalesce(tostring(LogonType), extract(@'<Data Name="LogonType">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            LogonProcessName = coalesce(LogonProcessName, extract(@'<Data Name="LogonProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            AuthenticationPackageName = coalesce(AuthenticationPackageName, PackageName, extract(@'<Data Name="AuthenticationPackageName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="PackageName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            WorkstationName = coalesce(WorkstationName, Workstation, extract(@'<Data Name="WorkstationName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="Workstation">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            IpAddress = coalesce(IpAddress, ClientAddress, extract(@'<Data Name="IpAddress">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="ClientAddress">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            IpPort = coalesce(IpPort, extract(@'<Data Name="IpPort">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="ClientPort">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ProcessName = coalesce(ProcessName, extract(@'<Data Name="ProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ElevatedToken = coalesce(ElevatedToken, extract(@'<Data Name="ElevatedToken">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            Status = coalesce(Status, extract(@'<Data Name="Status">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubStatus = coalesce(SubStatus, extract(@'<Data Name="SubStatus">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ServiceName = coalesce(ServiceName, extract(@'<Data Name="ServiceName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TicketEncryptionType = extract(@'<Data Name="TicketEncryptionType">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            TicketOptions = extract(@'<Data Name="TicketOptions">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            TargetServerName = coalesce(TargetServerName, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetServerName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            NewProcessName = coalesce(NewProcessName, extract(@'<Data Name="NewProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ParentProcessName = coalesce(ParentProcessName, extract(@'<Data Name="ParentProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            CommandLine = coalesce(CommandLine, extract(@'<Data Name="CommandLine">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TaskName = extract(@'<Data Name="TaskName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            TaskContent = coalesce(extract(@'<Data Name="TaskContent">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="TaskContentNew">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            MemberName = coalesce(MemberName, extract(@'<Data Name="MemberName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),

        | extend _dev = DeviceDetail, _loc = LocationDetails, _st = Status
        | project TimeGenerated, SourceTable = "SigninLogs", SignInType = "Interactive", UserPrincipalName, UserId, AppDisplayName, AppId,
            ResourceDisplayName, ResultType, ResultDescription, FailureReason = tostring(_st.failureReason), IPAddress, Location,
            City = tostring(_loc.city), AutonomousSystemNumber, ClientAppUsed, UserAgent, DeviceName = tostring(_dev.displayName),
            DeviceId = tostring(_dev.deviceId), OperatingSystem = tostring(_dev.operatingSystem), Browser = tostring(_dev.browser),
            IsManaged = tostring(_dev.isManaged), IsCompliant = tostring(_dev.isCompliant), TrustType = tostring(_dev.trustType),
            ConditionalAccessStatus, AuthenticationRequirement, RiskLevelDuringSignIn, SessionId, CorrelationId
    ),
    (
        AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where isempty(ip) or IPAddress == ip
        | where isempty(upn) or UserPrincipalName =~ upn
        | extend _dev = parse_json(DeviceDetail), _loc = parse_json(LocationDetails), _st = parse_json(Status)
        | project TimeGenerated, SourceTable = "AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs", SignInType = "NonInteractive", UserPrincipalName, UserId,
            AppDisplayName, AppId, ResourceDisplayName, ResultType, ResultDescription, FailureReason = tostring(_st.failureReason),
            IPAddress, Location, City = tostring(_loc.city), AutonomousSystemNumber, ClientAppUsed, UserAgent,
            DeviceName = tostring(_dev.displayName), DeviceId = tostring(_dev.deviceId), OperatingSystem = tostring(_dev.operatingSystem),
            Browser = tostring(_dev.browser), IsManaged = tostring(_dev.isManaged), IsCompliant = tostring(_dev.isCompliant),
            TrustType = tostring(_dev.trustType), ConditionalAccessStatus, AuthenticationRequirement, RiskLevelDuringSignIn, SessionId, CorrelationId
    ),
    (
        EntraIdSignInEvents
        | where Timestamp between (start .. end)
        | extend SignInType = iff(LogonType contains "noninteractive", "NonInteractive", "Interactive")
        | where (SignInType == "Interactive" and not(_HasInteractive)) or (SignInType == "NonInteractive" and not(_HasNonInteractive))
        | where isempty(ip) or IPAddress == ip
        | where isempty(upn) or AccountUpn =~ upn
        | project TimeGenerated = Timestamp, SourceTable = "EntraIdSignInEvents", SignInType, UserPrincipalName = AccountUpn,
            UserId = AccountObjectId, AppDisplayName = Application, AppId = ApplicationId, ResourceDisplayName,
            ResultType = tostring(ErrorCode), ResultDescription = "", FailureReason = "", IPAddress, Location = Country, City,
            AutonomousSystemNumber = "", ClientAppUsed, UserAgent, DeviceName, DeviceId = EntraIdDeviceId, OperatingSystem = OSPlatform,
            Browser, IsManaged = tostring(IsManaged == 1), IsCompliant = tostring(IsCompliant == 1), TrustType = DeviceTrustType,
            ConditionalAccessStatus = case(ConditionalAccessStatus == 0, "success", ConditionalAccessStatus == 1, "failure",
                ConditionalAccessStatus == 2, "notApplied", tostring(ConditionalAccessStatus)),
            AuthenticationRequirement,
            RiskLevelDuringSignIn = case(RiskLevelDuringSignIn == 100, "high", RiskLevelDuringSignIn == 50, "medium",
                RiskLevelDuringSignIn == 10, "low", RiskLevelDuringSignIn == 0, "none", tostring(RiskLevelDuringSignIn)),
            SessionId, CorrelationId
    )
    | extend Succeeded = ResultType == "0"
};
// Connexions Entra ID des applications (service principals) et des identités managées, normalisées :
// - Sentinel : AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs et AADManagedIdentitySignInLogs ;
// - Defender XDR : EntraIdSpnSignInEvents (IsManagedIdentity distingue les deux), lue seulement pour le type que les tables
//   Sentinel ne fournissent pas sur la période (pas de doublon dans le portail unifié).
// Paramètres : start, end, app (AppId, ServicePrincipalId ou nom ; vide = toutes), ip (vide = toutes).
let _SpnSignins = (start:datetime, end:datetime, app:string, ip:string) {
    let _HasSpn = toscalar(union isfuzzy=true
        (AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs | where TimeGenerated between ((start - 1d) .. end) | take 1 | project Present = 1),
        (print Present = 0)
        | summarize max(Present)) == 1;
    let _HasMi = toscalar(union isfuzzy=true
        (AADManagedIdentitySignInLogs | where TimeGenerated between ((start - 1d) .. end) | take 1 | project Present = 1),
        (print Present = 0)
        | summarize max(Present)) == 1;
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where isempty(app) or AppId == app or ServicePrincipalId == app or ServicePrincipalName =~ app
        | where isempty(ip) or IPAddress == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, SourceTable = "AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs", SignInType = "Service principal", ServicePrincipalName,
            ServicePrincipalId, AppId, ResourceDisplayName, ResultType, IPAddress, Location, Credential = ClientCredentialType,
            AppOwnerTenantId, HomeTenantId = AADTenantId
    ),
    (
        AADManagedIdentitySignInLogs
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where isempty(app) or AppId == app or ServicePrincipalId == app or ServicePrincipalName =~ app
        | where isempty(ip) or IPAddress == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, SourceTable = "AADManagedIdentitySignInLogs", SignInType = "Identité managée", ServicePrincipalName,
            ServicePrincipalId, AppId, ResourceDisplayName, ResultType, IPAddress, Location, Credential = "Identité managée",
            AppOwnerTenantId, HomeTenantId = TenantId
    ),
    (
        EntraIdSpnSignInEvents
        | where Timestamp between (start .. end)
        | extend SignInType = iff(IsManagedIdentity, "Identité managée", "Service principal")
        | where (SignInType == "Service principal" and not(_HasSpn)) or (SignInType == "Identité managée" and not(_HasMi))
        | where isempty(app) or ApplicationId == app or ServicePrincipalId == app or ServicePrincipalName =~ app or Application =~ app
        | where isempty(ip) or IPAddress == ip
        | project TimeGenerated = Timestamp, SourceTable = "EntraIdSpnSignInEvents", SignInType, ServicePrincipalName = coalesce(ServicePrincipalName, Application),
            ServicePrincipalId, AppId = ApplicationId, ResourceDisplayName, ResultType = tostring(ErrorCode), IPAddress, Location = Country,
            Credential = iff(IsManagedIdentity, "Identité managée", iff(IsConfidentialClient, "Client confidentiel", "Client public")),
            AppOwnerTenantId = "", HomeTenantId = ResourceTenantId
    )
    | extend Succeeded = ResultType == "0"
    // Origine de l'application : éditeur Microsoft, application du tenant, ou application d'un autre tenant (multi-tenant tierce)
    | extend AppOrigin = case(AppOwnerTenantId in ("f8cdef31-a31e-4b4a-93e4-5f571e91255a", "72f988bf-86f1-41af-91ab-2d7cd011db47"), "Microsoft (first-party)",
        SignInType == "Identité managée", "Identité managée du tenant",
        isempty(AppOwnerTenantId), "",
        AppOwnerTenantId == HomeTenantId, "Application du tenant",
        "Application d'un autre tenant")
};
// Toutes les sources de journaux où apparaît une adresse IP, ramenées à des colonnes communes :
// TimeGenerated, Source, EventType (EventID, ActionType ou opération), Host, AuthBy, Account, Detail.
// - Host : machine concernée par l'événement (la cible quand l'IP est la source, la machine de l'IP quand elle est la cible),
//   jamais le contrôleur de domaine qui a seulement validé des identifiants.
// - AuthBy : contrôleur de domaine (ou machine locale) qui a validé les identifiants (4768, 4769, 4771, 4776, Defender for Identity).
// Sources : Entra ID (utilisateurs et applications), audit Entra ID, Microsoft Graph, Windows, Defender for Endpoint et
// Defender for Identity, Sysmon 3, accès aux partages (5140, 5145), Microsoft 365, Azure, pare-feu et proxy (CEF, Azure
// Firewall, ASIM), messagerie, Linux (Syslog).
// @requires: win_security, sysmon, signins, spn_signins
let _IpEvents = (start:datetime, end:datetime, ip:string) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        _Signins(start, end, ip, "")
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = strcat("Entra ID (", SignInType, ")"), EventType = iff(Succeeded, "Connexion réussie", strcat("Échec ", ResultType)),
            Host = DeviceName, AuthBy = "", Account = tolower(UserPrincipalName), Detail = AppDisplayName
    ),
    (
        _SpnSignins(start, end, "", ip)
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = strcat("Entra ID (", SignInType, ")"), EventType = iff(Succeeded, "Connexion réussie", strcat("Échec ", ResultType)),
            Host = "", AuthBy = "", Account = tolower(ServicePrincipalName), Detail = ResourceDisplayName
    ),
    (
        AuditLogs
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress) == ip or tostring(InitiatedBy.app.ipAddress) == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "AuditLogs", EventType = OperationName, Host = "", AuthBy = "",
            Account = tolower(coalesce(tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName), tostring(InitiatedBy.app.displayName))),
            Detail = tostring(TargetResources[0].displayName)
    ),
    (
        MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where IPAddress == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs", EventType = strcat(RequestMethod, " ", tostring(ResponseStatusCode)),
            Host = "", AuthBy = "", Account = coalesce(UserId, ServicePrincipalId),
            Detail = replace_regex(tostring(parse_url(RequestUri).Path), @"[0-9a-fA-F-]{36}", "{id}")
    ),
    (
        _WinSecurity(start, end, dynamic([]), ip)
        | where IpAddress == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = SourceTable, EventType = strcat(tostring(EventID), " ", EventName),
            Host = TargetHost, AuthBy = AuthAuthority, Account = coalesce(TargetSam, SubjectSam),
            Detail = case(EventID in (5140, 5145), strcat(ShareName, " ", RelativeTargetName, " · ", ObjectAccess), LogonTypeName)
    ),
    (
        _Sysmon(start, end, dynamic([3]), ip)
        | where DestinationIp == ip or SourceIp == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "Sysmon 3", EventType = iff(Initiated == "true", "Connexion sortante", "Connexion entrante"),
            Host = Computer, AuthBy = "", Account = UserSam,
            Detail = strcat(ProcessFile, " → ", DestinationIp, ":", DestinationPort, iff(isempty(DestinationHostname), "", strcat(" (", DestinationHostname, ")")))
    ),
    (
        DeviceNetworkEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where RemoteIP == ip or LocalIP == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "DeviceNetworkEvents", EventType = ActionType, Host = DeviceName, AuthBy = "",
            Account = tolower(InitiatingProcessAccountName), Detail = strcat(InitiatingProcessFileName, " → ", RemoteIP, ":", tostring(RemotePort))
    ),
    (
        DeviceLogonEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where RemoteIP == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "DeviceLogonEvents", EventType = ActionType, Host = DeviceName, AuthBy = "",
            Account = tolower(AccountName), Detail = LogonType
    ),
    (
        IdentityLogonEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where IPAddress == ip or DestinationIPAddress == ip
        // IP source : la machine concernée est la cible (le DC de destination n'a fait que valider) ; IP destination : la machine source
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "IdentityLogonEvents", EventType = ActionType,
            Host = iff(IPAddress == ip, TargetDeviceName, DeviceName),
            AuthBy = iff(IPAddress == ip, DestinationDeviceName, ""),
            Account = tolower(coalesce(AccountUpn, AccountName)), Detail = strcat(Application, " ", Protocol)
    ),
    (
        IdentityQueryEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where IPAddress == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "IdentityQueryEvents", EventType = strcat(ActionType, " ", QueryType), Host = DeviceName,
            AuthBy = DestinationDeviceName, Account = tolower(coalesce(AccountUpn, AccountName)), Detail = strcat(Protocol, " ", QueryTarget)
    ),
    (
        IdentityDirectoryEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where IPAddress == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "IdentityDirectoryEvents", EventType = ActionType, Host = coalesce(TargetDeviceName, DeviceName),
            AuthBy = DestinationDeviceName, Account = tolower(coalesce(AccountUpn, AccountName)), Detail = strcat(Application, " ", Protocol)
    ),
    (
        ASimAuthenticationEventLogs
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where SrcIpAddr == ip or TargetIpAddr == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = strcat("ASimAuthenticationEventLogs (", EventProduct, ")"), EventType = strcat(EventType, " ", EventResult),
            Host = iff(SrcIpAddr == ip, coalesce(TargetHostname, DvcHostname), SrcHostname), AuthBy = "",
            Account = tolower(TargetUsername), Detail = strcat(LogonProtocol, " ", LogonMethod)
    ),
    (
        CloudAppEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where IPAddress == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "CloudAppEvents", EventType = ActionType, Host = "", AuthBy = "",
            Account = tolower(coalesce(tostring(RawEventData.UserId), AccountDisplayName)), Detail = Application
    ),
    (
        OfficeActivity
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where ClientIP has ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "OfficeActivity", EventType = Operation, Host = "", AuthBy = "",
            Account = tolower(UserId), Detail = OfficeWorkload
    ),
    (
        AzureActivity
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where CallerIpAddress == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "AzureActivity", EventType = OperationNameValue, Host = "", AuthBy = "",
            Account = tolower(Caller), Detail = ResourceGroup
    ),
    (
        CommonSecurityLog
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where SourceIP == ip or DestinationIP == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = strcat("CommonSecurityLog (", DeviceVendor, ")"), EventType = coalesce(DeviceAction, Activity),
            Host = iff(SourceIP == ip, DestinationHostName, SourceHostName), AuthBy = "",
            Account = tolower(coalesce(SourceUserName, DestinationUserName)), Detail = strcat(SourceIP, " → ", DestinationIP, ":", tostring(DestinationPort))
    ),
    (
        ASimNetworkSessionLogs
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where SrcIpAddr == ip or DstIpAddr == ip or SrcNatIpAddr == ip or DstNatIpAddr == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = strcat("ASimNetworkSessionLogs (", EventProduct, ")"), EventType = coalesce(DvcAction, EventResult),
            Host = iff(DstIpAddr == ip or DstNatIpAddr == ip, SrcHostname, DstHostname), AuthBy = "", Account = tolower(SrcUsername),
            Detail = strcat(SrcIpAddr, " → ", DstIpAddr, ":", tostring(DstPortNumber))
    ),
    (
        ASimWebSessionLogs
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where SrcIpAddr == ip or DstIpAddr == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = strcat("ASimWebSessionLogs (", EventProduct, ")"), EventType = coalesce(DvcAction, EventResult),
            Host = SrcHostname, AuthBy = "", Account = tolower(SrcUsername), Detail = Url
    ),
    (
        AZFWNetworkRule
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where SourceIp == ip or DestinationIp == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "AZFWNetworkRule", EventType = Action, Host = "", AuthBy = "", Account = "",
            Detail = strcat(SourceIp, " → ", DestinationIp, ":", tostring(DestinationPort), " ", Protocol)
    ),
    (
        AZFWApplicationRule
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where SourceIp == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "AZFWApplicationRule", EventType = Action, Host = "", AuthBy = "", Account = "",
            Detail = coalesce(TargetUrl, Fqdn)
    ),
    (
        EmailEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where SenderIPv4 == ip or SenderIPv6 == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "EmailEvents", EventType = DeliveryAction, Host = "", AuthBy = "",
            Account = tolower(SenderFromAddress), Detail = Subject
    ),
    (
        UrlClickEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where IPAddress == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "UrlClickEvents", EventType = ActionType, Host = "", AuthBy = "",
            Account = tolower(AccountUpn), Detail = Url
    ),
    (
        Syslog
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where SyslogMessage has ip or HostIP == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = strcat("Syslog (", ProcessName, ")"), EventType = SeverityLevel, Host = Computer, AuthBy = "",
            Account = tolower(extract(@"(?:Accepted|Failed) \S+ for (?:invalid user )?(\S+) from", 1, SyslogMessage)),
            Detail = substring(SyslogMessage, 0, 300)
    )
    | extend Host = tolower(Host), AuthBy = tolower(AuthBy)
};
_IpEvents(StartTimestamp, EndTimestamp, Value)
| summarize Events = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 10m), Serie = strcat(Source, " · ", EventType)
| render timechart

rules.name: Utilisation par jour, par machine
rules.description: Tableau croisé machine × jour du nombre d'événements où l'IP apparaît (connexions réseau Defender, journaux Windows, Defender for Identity, pare-feu, Linux). La machine est la cible réelle de l'événement : un contrôleur de domaine qui n'a fait que valider des identifiants (4768, 4769, 4771, 4776) apparaît à part, suffixé « validation des identifiants ». Le rôle connu de chaque machine (DC, serveur déclaré dans la watchlist) est indiqué entre crochets.

reading.decisive: Machines touchées uniquement le jour de l'alerte, alors que l'IP existait déjà avant.
reading.context: Nombre de machines qui augmente d'un jour à l'autre (balayage, mouvement latéral).
reading.noise: Serveurs de supervision, d'inventaire ou de sauvegarde contactés tous les jours ; lignes « validation des identifiants » des DC.

rules.query:
// [IP-S3] Utilisation par jour, par machine — Statistics / Adresse IP
// sentinel-pivot-rules 0.2.0. Paramètres : {{VALUE}}, {{T0}}, {{BEFORE_MIN}}, {{AFTER_MIN}}
let Value = trim(@"\s", @"{{VALUE}}");
let T0 = coalesce(todatetime(@"{{T0}}"), now());
let Before = coalesce(tolong(@"{{BEFORE_MIN}}"), 10080) * 1m; // défaut : 7d
let After = coalesce(tolong(@"{{AFTER_MIN}}"), 1440) * 1m; // défaut : 1d
let StartTimestamp = T0 - Before;
let EndTimestamp = T0 + After;

let _WinEventName = (id:int) {
    case(
        id == 4624, "Ouverture de session réussie",
        id == 4625, "Échec d'ouverture de session",
        id == 4634, "Fermeture de session",
        id == 4647, "Déconnexion initiée par l'utilisateur",
        id == 4648, "Ouverture avec identifiants explicites",
        id == 4656, "Handle demandé sur un objet",
        id == 4657, "Valeur de registre modifiée",
        id == 4658, "Handle fermé",
        id == 4660, "Objet supprimé",
        id == 4663, "Accès à un objet",
        id == 4670, "Permissions d'un objet modifiées",
        id == 4672, "Privilèges spéciaux attribués",
        id == 4688, "Création de processus",
        id == 4697, "Service installé",
        id == 4698, "Tâche planifiée créée",
        id == 4702, "Tâche planifiée modifiée",
        id == 4720, "Compte utilisateur créé",
        id == 4722, "Compte utilisateur activé",
        id == 4724, "Réinitialisation de mot de passe",
        id == 4728, "Membre ajouté à un groupe global de sécurité",
        id == 4732, "Membre ajouté à un groupe local de sécurité",
        id == 4740, "Compte verrouillé",
        id == 4756, "Membre ajouté à un groupe universel de sécurité",
        id == 4768, "Ticket Kerberos TGT demandé",
        id == 4769, "Ticket de service Kerberos demandé",
        id == 4771, "Échec de pré-authentification Kerberos",
        id == 4776, "Validation d'identifiants NTLM",
        id == 4778, "Session RDP reconnectée",
        id == 4779, "Session RDP déconnectée",
        id == 5140, "Accès à un partage réseau",
        id == 5145, "Contrôle d'accès à un objet de partage",
        strcat("EventID ", tostring(id)))
};
let _LogonTypeName = (t:string) {
    case(
        t == "2", "Interactive",
        t == "3", "Network",
        t == "4", "Batch",
        t == "5", "Service",
        t == "7", "Unlock",
        t == "8", "NetworkCleartext",
        t == "9", "NewCredentials",
        t == "10", "RemoteInteractive",
        t == "11", "CachedInteractive",
        t)
};
// Événements de sécurité Windows normalisés, quelle que soit la table d'ingestion :
// Pour les SecurityEvent, on reparse les champs depuis le EventData XML si il y a des bugs, avec une regex (ajouté au moment du build)
// Paramètres : start, end (fenêtre), ids (liste d'EventID, vide = tous), term (pré-filtre texte, vide = aucun ;
// recherché dans le XML brut et dans les colonnes de compte, de machine, d'IP et de processus).
// Colonnes ajoutées pour ne pas confondre la machine qui journalise avec la machine utilisée :
// - TargetHost : machine réellement visée. 4769 : la machine du service demandé (ServiceName « FS01$ ») ; 4648 : TargetServerName ;
//   4768, 4771, 4776 : vide (simple validation d'identifiants, la cible n'est pas connue) ; sinon : Computer.
// - AuthAuthority : machine qui a validé les identifiants (DC, ou la machine elle-même pour un compte local en NTLM) pour
//   4768, 4769, 4771 et 4776 ; vide sinon.
// - SourceHost : poste d'origine déclaré (WorkstationName), à défaut l'IP source.
// - ObjectAccess : droits demandés sur un fichier, une clé ou un partage (lecture, écriture, suppression, permissions,
//   exécution) pour 4656, 4657, 4660, 4663, 4670, 5140 et 5145 (audit « Système de fichiers », « Registre », « Partage de
//   fichiers détaillé » : rien n'est produit sans stratégie d'audit et, pour les fichiers et le registre, sans SACL).
// Fragment propre à Sentinel : retiré de la variante Defender (les règles l'appellent dans des blocs @sentinel-only).
// @requires: win_names
// @sentinel-only:begin
let _WinSecurity = (start:datetime, end:datetime, ids:dynamic, term:string) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        SecurityEvent
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where array_length(ids) == 0 or EventID in (ids)
        | where isempty(term) or EventData has term or Computer has term or IpAddress has term or TargetUserName has term
            or SubjectUserName has term or WorkstationName has term or NewProcessName has term or ParentProcessName has term
            or TargetServerName has term
        | extend _x = tostring(EventData)
        | extend
            SubjectUserSid = coalesce(SubjectUserSid, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectUserSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectUserName = coalesce(SubjectUserName, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectUserName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectDomainName = coalesce(SubjectDomainName, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectDomainName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectLogonId = coalesce(SubjectLogonId, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectLogonId">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetUserSid = coalesce(TargetUserSid, TargetSid, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetUserSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetUserName = coalesce(TargetUserName, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetUserName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetDomainName = coalesce(TargetDomainName, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetDomainName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetLogonId = coalesce(TargetLogonId, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetLogonId">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            LogonType = coalesce(tostring(LogonType), extract(@'<Data Name="LogonType">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            LogonProcessName = coalesce(LogonProcessName, extract(@'<Data Name="LogonProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            AuthenticationPackageName = coalesce(AuthenticationPackageName, PackageName, extract(@'<Data Name="AuthenticationPackageName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="PackageName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            WorkstationName = coalesce(WorkstationName, Workstation, extract(@'<Data Name="WorkstationName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="Workstation">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            IpAddress = coalesce(IpAddress, ClientAddress, extract(@'<Data Name="IpAddress">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="ClientAddress">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            IpPort = coalesce(IpPort, extract(@'<Data Name="IpPort">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="ClientPort">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ProcessName = coalesce(ProcessName, extract(@'<Data Name="ProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ElevatedToken = coalesce(ElevatedToken, extract(@'<Data Name="ElevatedToken">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            Status = coalesce(Status, extract(@'<Data Name="Status">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubStatus = coalesce(SubStatus, extract(@'<Data Name="SubStatus">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ServiceName = coalesce(ServiceName, extract(@'<Data Name="ServiceName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TicketEncryptionType = extract(@'<Data Name="TicketEncryptionType">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            TicketOptions = extract(@'<Data Name="TicketOptions">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            TargetServerName = coalesce(TargetServerName, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetServerName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            NewProcessName = coalesce(NewProcessName, extract(@'<Data Name="NewProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ParentProcessName = coalesce(ParentProcessName, extract(@'<Data Name="ParentProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
