        (AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs | where TimeGenerated between ((start - 1d) .. end) | take 1 | project Present = 1),
        (print Present = 0)
        | summarize max(Present)) == 1;
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        SigninLogs
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where isempty(ip) or IPAddress == ip
        | where isempty(upn) or UserPrincipalName =~ upn
        | extend _dev = DeviceDetail, _loc = LocationDetails, _st = Status
        | project TimeGenerated, SourceTable = "SigninLogs", SignInType = "Interactive", UserPrincipalName, UserId, AppDisplayName, AppId,
            ResourceDisplayName, ResultType, ResultDescription, FailureReason = tostring(_st.failureReason), IPAddress, Location,
            City = tostring(_loc.city), AutonomousSystemNumber, ClientAppUsed, UserAgent, DeviceName = tostring(_dev.displayName),
            DeviceId = tostring(_dev.deviceId), OperatingSystem = tostring(_dev.operatingSystem), Browser = tostring(_dev.browser),
            IsManaged = tostring(_dev.isManaged), IsCompliant = tostring(_dev.isCompliant), TrustType = tostring(_dev.trustType),
            ConditionalAccessStatus, AuthenticationRequirement, RiskLevelDuringSignIn, SessionId, CorrelationId
    ),
    (
        AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where isempty(ip) or IPAddress == ip
        | where isempty(upn) or UserPrincipalName =~ upn
        | extend _dev = parse_json(DeviceDetail), _loc = parse_json(LocationDetails), _st = parse_json(Status)
        | project TimeGenerated, SourceTable = "AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs", SignInType = "NonInteractive", UserPrincipalName, UserId,
            AppDisplayName, AppId, ResourceDisplayName, ResultType, ResultDescription, FailureReason = tostring(_st.failureReason),
            IPAddress, Location, City = tostring(_loc.city), AutonomousSystemNumber, ClientAppUsed, UserAgent,
            DeviceName = tostring(_dev.displayName), DeviceId = tostring(_dev.deviceId), OperatingSystem = tostring(_dev.operatingSystem),
            Browser = tostring(_dev.browser), IsManaged = tostring(_dev.isManaged), IsCompliant = tostring(_dev.isCompliant),
            TrustType = tostring(_dev.trustType), ConditionalAccessStatus, AuthenticationRequirement, RiskLevelDuringSignIn, SessionId, CorrelationId
    ),
    (
        EntraIdSignInEvents
        | where Timestamp between (start .. end)
        | extend SignInType = iff(LogonType contains "noninteractive", "NonInteractive", "Interactive")
        | where (SignInType == "Interactive" and not(_HasInteractive)) or (SignInType == "NonInteractive" and not(_HasNonInteractive))
        | where isempty(ip) or IPAddress == ip
        | where isempty(upn) or AccountUpn =~ upn
        | project TimeGenerated = Timestamp, SourceTable = "EntraIdSignInEvents", SignInType, UserPrincipalName = AccountUpn,
            UserId = AccountObjectId, AppDisplayName = Application, AppId = ApplicationId, ResourceDisplayName,
            ResultType = tostring(ErrorCode), ResultDescription = "", FailureReason = "", IPAddress, Location = Country, City,
            AutonomousSystemNumber = "", ClientAppUsed, UserAgent, DeviceName, DeviceId = EntraIdDeviceId, OperatingSystem = OSPlatform,
            Browser, IsManaged = tostring(IsManaged == 1), IsCompliant = tostring(IsCompliant == 1), TrustType = DeviceTrustType,
            ConditionalAccessStatus = case(ConditionalAccessStatus == 0, "success", ConditionalAccessStatus == 1, "failure",
                ConditionalAccessStatus == 2, "notApplied", tostring(ConditionalAccessStatus)),
            AuthenticationRequirement,
            RiskLevelDuringSignIn = case(RiskLevelDuringSignIn == 100, "high", RiskLevelDuringSignIn == 50, "medium",
                RiskLevelDuringSignIn == 10, "low", RiskLevelDuringSignIn == 0, "none", tostring(RiskLevelDuringSignIn)),
            SessionId, CorrelationId
    )
    | extend Succeeded = ResultType == "0"
};
// Connexions Entra ID des applications (service principals) et des identités managées, normalisées :
// - Sentinel : AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs et AADManagedIdentitySignInLogs ;
// - Defender XDR : EntraIdSpnSignInEvents (IsManagedIdentity distingue les deux), lue seulement pour le type que les tables
//   Sentinel ne fournissent pas sur la période (pas de doublon dans le portail unifié).
// Paramètres : start, end, app (AppId, ServicePrincipalId ou nom ; vide = toutes), ip (vide = toutes).
let _SpnSignins = (start:datetime, end:datetime, app:string, ip:string) {
    let _HasSpn = toscalar(union isfuzzy=true
        (AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs | where TimeGenerated between ((start - 1d) .. end) | take 1 | project Present = 1),
        (print Present = 0)
        | summarize max(Present)) == 1;
    let _HasMi = toscalar(union isfuzzy=true
        (AADManagedIdentitySignInLogs | where TimeGenerated between ((start - 1d) .. end) | take 1 | project Present = 1),
        (print Present = 0)
        | summarize max(Present)) == 1;
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where isempty(app) or AppId == app or ServicePrincipalId == app or ServicePrincipalName =~ app
        | where isempty(ip) or IPAddress == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, SourceTable = "AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs", SignInType = "Service principal", ServicePrincipalName,
            ServicePrincipalId, AppId, ResourceDisplayName, ResultType, IPAddress, Location, Credential = ClientCredentialType,
            AppOwnerTenantId, HomeTenantId = AADTenantId
    ),
    (
        AADManagedIdentitySignInLogs
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where isempty(app) or AppId == app or ServicePrincipalId == app or ServicePrincipalName =~ app
        | where isempty(ip) or IPAddress == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, SourceTable = "AADManagedIdentitySignInLogs", SignInType = "Identité managée", ServicePrincipalName,
            ServicePrincipalId, AppId, ResourceDisplayName, ResultType, IPAddress, Location, Credential = "Identité managée",
            AppOwnerTenantId, HomeTenantId = TenantId
    ),
    (
        EntraIdSpnSignInEvents
        | where Timestamp between (start .. end)
        | extend SignInType = iff(IsManagedIdentity, "Identité managée", "Service principal")
        | where (SignInType == "Service principal" and not(_HasSpn)) or (SignInType == "Identité managée" and not(_HasMi))
        | where isempty(app) or ApplicationId == app or ServicePrincipalId == app or ServicePrincipalName =~ app or Application =~ app
        | where isempty(ip) or IPAddress == ip
        | project TimeGenerated = Timestamp, SourceTable = "EntraIdSpnSignInEvents", SignInType, ServicePrincipalName = coalesce(ServicePrincipalName, Application),
            ServicePrincipalId, AppId = ApplicationId, ResourceDisplayName, ResultType = tostring(ErrorCode), IPAddress, Location = Country,
            Credential = iff(IsManagedIdentity, "Identité managée", iff(IsConfidentialClient, "Client confidentiel", "Client public")),
            AppOwnerTenantId = "", HomeTenantId = ResourceTenantId
    )
    | extend Succeeded = ResultType == "0"
    // Origine de l'application : éditeur Microsoft, application du tenant, ou application d'un autre tenant (multi-tenant tierce)
    | extend AppOrigin = case(AppOwnerTenantId in ("f8cdef31-a31e-4b4a-93e4-5f571e91255a", "72f988bf-86f1-41af-91ab-2d7cd011db47"), "Microsoft (first-party)",
        SignInType == "Identité managée", "Identité managée du tenant",
        isempty(AppOwnerTenantId), "",
        AppOwnerTenantId == HomeTenantId, "Application du tenant",
        "Application d'un autre tenant")
};
union isfuzzy=true
(
    _Signins(StartTimestamp, EndTimestamp, Value, "")
    | project TimeGenerated, Service = "Entra ID", Operation = strcat("Connexion à ", AppDisplayName), Target = ResourceDisplayName,
        Account = tolower(UserPrincipalName), Result = iff(Succeeded, "Succès", strcat("Échec ", ResultType))
),
(
    _SpnSignins(StartTimestamp, EndTimestamp, "", Value)
    | project TimeGenerated, Service = strcat("Entra ID (", SignInType, ")"), Operation = strcat("Connexion à ", ResourceDisplayName),
        Target = ResourceDisplayName, Account = tolower(ServicePrincipalName), Result = iff(Succeeded, "Succès", strcat("Échec ", ResultType))
),
(
    AuditLogs
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTimestamp .. EndTimestamp)
    | where tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress) == Value or tostring(InitiatedBy.app.ipAddress) == Value
    | project TimeGenerated, Service = "Annuaire Entra ID", Operation = OperationName, Target = tostring(TargetResources[0].displayName),
        Account = tolower(coalesce(tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName), tostring(InitiatedBy.app.displayName))), Result
),
(
    MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTimestamp .. EndTimestamp)
    | where IPAddress == Value
    | project TimeGenerated, Service = "Microsoft Graph",
        Operation = strcat(RequestMethod, " ", replace_regex(tostring(parse_url(RequestUri).Path), @"[0-9a-fA-F-]{36}", "{id}")),
        Target = "", Account = coalesce(UserId, ServicePrincipalId), Result = tostring(ResponseStatusCode)
),
(
    CloudAppEvents
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTimestamp .. EndTimestamp)
    | where IPAddress == Value
    | project TimeGenerated, Service = Application, Operation = ActionType, Target = ObjectName,
        Account = tolower(coalesce(tostring(RawEventData.UserId), AccountDisplayName)), Result = ""
),
(
    OfficeActivity
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTimestamp .. EndTimestamp)
    | where ClientIP has Value
    | project TimeGenerated, Service = OfficeWorkload, Operation, Target = coalesce(OfficeObjectId, SourceFileName),
        Account = tolower(UserId), Result = ResultStatus
),
(
    AzureActivity
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTimestamp .. EndTimestamp)
    | where CallerIpAddress == Value
    | project TimeGenerated, Service = "Azure Resource Manager", Operation = OperationNameValue, Target = _ResourceId,
        Account = tolower(Caller), Result = ActivityStatusValue
),
(
    AZKVAuditLogs
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTimestamp .. EndTimestamp)
    | where CallerIpAddress == Value
    | extend Id = parse_json(tostring(Identity))
    | project TimeGenerated, Service = "Key Vault", Operation = OperationName, Target = _ResourceId,
        Account = tolower(coalesce(tostring(Id.claim.upn), tostring(Id.claim.appid))), Result = ResultSignature
),
(
    AzureDiagnostics
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTimestamp .. EndTimestamp)
    | where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.KEYVAULT" and CallerIPAddress == Value
    | project TimeGenerated, Service = "Key Vault", Operation = OperationName, Target = Resource,
        Account = tolower(coalesce(column_ifexists("identity_claim_http_schemas_xmlsoap_org_ws_2005_05_identity_claims_upn_s", ""), column_ifexists("identity_claim_appid_g", ""))),
        Result = ResultSignature
),
(
    StorageBlobLogs
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTimestamp .. EndTimestamp)
    | where CallerIpAddress startswith strcat(Value, ":") or CallerIpAddress == Value
    | project TimeGenerated, Service = strcat("Stockage Blob ", AccountName), Operation = OperationName, Target = ObjectKey,
        Account = tolower(coalesce(RequesterUpn, RequesterObjectId, AuthenticationType)), Result = StatusText
)
| summarize Events = count(), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
    Accounts = make_set(Account, 10), Targets = make_set(Target, 10), Results = make_set(Result, 5) by Service, Operation
| sort by Service asc, Events desc

rules.name: Processus ayant contacté l'IP
rules.description: Processus, machines et comptes à l'origine des connexions vers l'IP (ou depuis l'IP quand elle est locale), avec ports, URL et premier et dernier contact. Inclut l'écart médian entre connexions pour repérer un balisage. Defender for Endpoint, complété dans Sentinel par Sysmon 3 et par les sessions réseau ASIM qui portent un nom d'application (pare-feu applicatifs). Le rôle de la machine (DC, serveur déclaré) et la catégorie du compte (système, service) sont indiqués.

reading.decisive: Binaire signé légitime (rundll32, msiexec, node.exe, mshta) ou processus hors dossier d'installation qui parle à une IP publique.
reading.context: Écart médian régulier entre connexions (balise C2) ou destination contactée depuis une seule machine.
reading.noise: Navigateurs, agents de mise à jour et outils de sécurité qui contactent des IP de CDN.

rules.query:
// [IP-P4] Processus ayant contacté l'IP — Pivot / Adresse IP
// sentinel-pivot-rules 0.2.0. Paramètres : {{VALUE}}, {{T0}}, {{BEFORE_MIN}}, {{AFTER_MIN}}
let Value = trim(@"\s", @"{{VALUE}}");
let T0 = coalesce(todatetime(@"{{T0}}"), now());
let Before = coalesce(tolong(@"{{BEFORE_MIN}}"), 60) * 1m; // défaut : 1h
let After = coalesce(tolong(@"{{AFTER_MIN}}"), 60) * 1m; // défaut : 1h
let StartTimestamp = T0 - Before;
let EndTimestamp = T0 + After;

// Rôles des entités (machines, IP, comptes) : distingue « où l'événement est journalisé » de « où l'entité est utilisée »
// et signale les entités qui faussent un pivot (contrôleur de domaine, NAT, proxy, compte de service…).
// Trois sources, combinées :
// 1. détection automatique des contrôleurs de domaine (DC) : émetteurs de 4768 (seul un KDC en produit), cibles LDAP vues par
//    Defender for Identity, machines qui acceptent des connexions Kerberos (port 88) selon Defender for Endpoint ;
// 2. watchlist Sentinel « EasyPivotRoles » (colonnes Entity, Type, Role, Note), modèle dans watchlists/EasyPivotRoles.csv ;
// 3. comptes : IdentityInfo (rôles Entra ID, groupes AD privilégiés, compte de service, étiquettes Defender for Identity)
//    et noms réservés (compte machine, compte système, krbtgt, synchronisation Entra Connect).
// Chaque fonction prend l'instant de référence `at` et regarde la journée qui précède (14 jours pour IdentityInfo).
// Les blocs « @sentinel-only » sont retirés de la variante Defender XDR (tables absentes de Defender).
//
// _HostKey(h) : nom court en minuscules (FQDN, NetBIOS, compte machine « PC01$ » → « pc01 ») ; vide pour une adresse IP.
let _HostKey = (h:string) {
    iff(isnotnull(parse_ipv4(h)) or h contains ":", "", tolower(tostring(split(trim_end(@"\$", trim(@"[\s\\]+", h)), ".")[0])))
};
// _SamOf(a) : nom SAM d'un compte, depuis « DOMAINE\nom », « nom@domaine » ou « nom ».
let _SamOf = (a:string) { tolower(tostring(split(tostring(split(a, "@")[0]), @"\")[-1])) };
// _Labeled(nom, rôle) : « dc01 [DC] », pour annoter les listes (make_set) sans ajouter de colonne.
let _Labeled = (name:string, role:string) { iff(isempty(role), name, strcat(name, " [", role, "]")) };
// _JoinRoles(a, b) : concatène deux libellés de rôle en ignorant les vides.
let _JoinRoles = (a:string, b:string) { strcat_array(set_difference(pack_array(a, b), dynamic([""])), ", ") };
// _AccountKind(nom SAM) : catégorie déduite du nom seul.
let _AccountKind = (sam:string) {
    case(
        sam endswith "$", "Compte machine",
        sam in ("system", "local system", "local service", "network service", "anonymous logon", "iusr", "-")
            or sam startswith "dwm-" or sam startswith "umfd-", "Compte système",
        sam == "krbtgt", "Compte KDC (krbtgt)",
        sam startswith "msol_" or sam startswith "sync_" or sam startswith "aad_" or sam startswith "adtoaadsyncserviceaccount",
            "Synchronisation Entra Connect",
        sam in ("administrator", "administrateur"), "Administrateur intégré",
        "")
};
// _DcEvidence(at) : machines (et IP) qui se comportent comme des contrôleurs de domaine.
let _DcEvidence = (at:datetime) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        datatable(Machine:string, Ip:string, Basis:string)[]
    ),
    // @sentinel-only:begin
    (
        SecurityEvent
        | where TimeGenerated between ((at - 1d) .. at)
        | where EventID == 4768
        | summarize by Computer
        | project Machine = Computer, Ip = "", Basis = "Émet des 4768 (KDC)"
    ),
    (
        WindowsEvent
        | where TimeGenerated between ((at - 1d) .. at)
        | where Provider == "Microsoft-Windows-Security-Auditing" and EventID == 4768
        | summarize by Computer
        | project Machine = Computer, Ip = "", Basis = "Émet des 4768 (KDC)"
    ),
    // @sentinel-only:end
    (
        IdentityQueryEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between ((at - 1d) .. at)
        | where Protocol =~ "Ldap" and isnotempty(DestinationDeviceName)
        | summarize by DestinationDeviceName, DestinationIPAddress
        | project Machine = DestinationDeviceName, Ip = DestinationIPAddress, Basis = "Cible LDAP (Defender for Identity)"
    ),
    (
        DeviceNetworkEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between ((at - 1d) .. at)
        | where LocalPort == 88 and ActionType in ("InboundConnectionAccepted", "ListeningConnectionCreated")
        | summarize by DeviceName, LocalIP
        | project Machine = DeviceName, Ip = LocalIP, Basis = "Accepte Kerberos sur le port 88 (Defender for Endpoint)"
    )
};
// _MachineRoles(at) : MachineKey (nom court), MachineRole (« DC, Serveur de fichiers »), MachineRoleBasis (preuves).
let _MachineRoles = (at:datetime) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        datatable(MachineKey:string, Role:string, Basis:string)[]
    ),
    (
        _DcEvidence(at)
        | project MachineKey = _HostKey(Machine), Role = "DC", Basis
    ),
    (
        Watchlist
        | where WatchlistAlias =~ "EasyPivotRoles" and _DTItemType == "watchlist-item"
        | summarize arg_max(_DTTimestamp, _DTItemStatus, WatchlistItem) by _DTItemId
        | where _DTItemStatus != "Deleted"
        | where tolower(tostring(WatchlistItem.Type)) in ("machine", "host", "device", "serveur", "poste")
        | project MachineKey = _HostKey(tostring(WatchlistItem.Entity)), Role = tostring(WatchlistItem.Role),
            Basis = strcat("Watchlist EasyPivotRoles ", tostring(WatchlistItem.Note))
    )
    | where isnotempty(MachineKey) and isnotempty(Role)
    | summarize MachineRoles = make_set(Role), MachineRoleBasis = make_set(Basis, 5) by MachineKey
    | project MachineKey, MachineRole = strcat_array(MachineRoles, ", "), MachineRoleBasis
};
// _IpRoles(at) : Ip (adresse exacte ou plage CIDR), IpRole, IpRoleBasis.
let _IpRoles = (at:datetime) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        datatable(Ip:string, Role:string, Basis:string)[]
    ),
    (
        _DcEvidence(at)
        | where isnotempty(Ip)
        | project Ip, Role = "DC", Basis
    ),
    (
        Watchlist
        | where WatchlistAlias =~ "EasyPivotRoles" and _DTItemType == "watchlist-item"
        | summarize arg_max(_DTTimestamp, _DTItemStatus, WatchlistItem) by _DTItemId
        | where _DTItemStatus != "Deleted"
        | where tolower(tostring(WatchlistItem.Type)) in ("ip", "plage", "cidr", "subnet", "réseau")
        | project Ip = trim(@"\s", tostring(WatchlistItem.Entity)), Role = tostring(WatchlistItem.Role),
            Basis = strcat("Watchlist EasyPivotRoles ", tostring(WatchlistItem.Note))
    )
    | where isnotempty(Ip) and isnotempty(Role)
    | summarize IpRoles = make_set(Role), IpRoleBasis = make_set(Basis, 5) by Ip
    | project Ip, IpRole = strcat_array(IpRoles, ", "), IpRoleBasis
};
// _IpRoleOf(ip, at) : rôles connus d'une adresse, y compris par appartenance à une plage CIDR de la watchlist.
let _IpRoleOf = (ip:string, at:datetime) {
    toscalar(_IpRoles(at)
        | where Ip == ip or (Ip has "/" and ipv4_is_in_range(ip, Ip))
        | summarize Roles = strcat_array(make_set(IpRole), ", "))
};
// _AccountRoles(at) : AccountKey (nom SAM ou UPN, en minuscules), AccountRole, AccountRoleBasis.
let _AccountRoles = (at:datetime) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        datatable(AccountKey:string, Role:string, Basis:string)[]
    ),
    (
        IdentityInfo
        | where TimeGenerated between ((at - 14d) .. at)
        | extend Sam = tolower(coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists("SAMAccountName", "")), AccountName)),
            Upn = tolower(coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists("AccountUPN", "")), tostring(column_ifexists("AccountUpn", "")))),
            EntraRoles = tostring(column_ifexists("AssignedRoles", dynamic([]))),
            Groups = tostring(column_ifexists("GroupMembership", dynamic([]))),
            IsSvc = tobool(column_ifexists("IsServiceAccount", false)),
            IdTags = tostring(column_ifexists("Tags", ""))
        | where isnotempty(Sam)
        | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, Upn, EntraRoles, Groups, IsSvc, IdTags) by Sam
        | extend Roles = pack_array(
            iff(EntraRoles in ("", "[]", "null"), "", "Rôle Entra ID attribué"),
            iff(Groups has_any ("Domain Admins", "Enterprise Admins", "Schema Admins", "Account Operators", "Backup Operators",
                    "Server Operators", "Admins du domaine", "Administrateurs de l'entreprise", "Administrateurs du schéma",
                    "Opérateurs de compte", "Opérateurs de sauvegarde", "Opérateurs de serveur"), "Groupe AD privilégié", ""),
            iff(IsSvc, "Compte de service", ""),
            iff(IdTags has_any ("Sensitive", "Sensible"), "Compte sensible", ""),
            iff(IdTags has "Honeytoken", "Compte leurre", ""))
        | mv-expand Role = Roles to typeof(string)
        | where isnotempty(Role)
        | mv-expand AccountKey = pack_array(Sam, Upn) to typeof(string)
        | project AccountKey, Role, Basis = "IdentityInfo"
    ),
    (
        Watchlist
        | where WatchlistAlias =~ "EasyPivotRoles" and _DTItemType == "watchlist-item"
        | summarize arg_max(_DTTimestamp, _DTItemStatus, WatchlistItem) by _DTItemId
        | where _DTItemStatus != "Deleted"
        | where tolower(tostring(WatchlistItem.Type)) in ("compte", "account", "user", "utilisateur")
        | extend Raw = tolower(trim(@"\s", tostring(WatchlistItem.Entity)))
        | mv-expand AccountKey = pack_array(Raw, _SamOf(Raw)) to typeof(string)
        | project AccountKey, Role = tostring(WatchlistItem.Role), Basis = strcat("Watchlist EasyPivotRoles ", tostring(WatchlistItem.Note))
    )
    | where isnotempty(AccountKey) and isnotempty(Role)
    | summarize AccountRoles = make_set(Role), AccountRoleBasis = make_set(Basis, 5) by AccountKey
    | project AccountKey, AccountRole = strcat_array(AccountRoles, ", "), AccountRoleBasis
};
// Événements Sysmon (journal Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational) normalisés, quelle que soit la table d'ingestion :
// Event (agent Azure Monitor, EventData en XML) ou WindowsEvent (transfert d'événements, EventData en JSON).
// Paramètres : start, end, ids (EventID, vide = tous), term (pré-filtre texte sur les données et le nom de machine, vide = aucun).
// Colonnes de Sysmon (Image, CommandLine, ParentImage, User, Hashes, TargetFilename, ImageLoaded, TargetObject, Details,
// SourceIp, DestinationIp, DestinationPort, DestinationHostname, QueryName, QueryResults…) et colonnes dérivées :
// Contents (flux Zone.Identifier de l'événement 15 : HostUrl et ReferrerUrl du téléchargement).
// ProcessFile, ParentFile, TargetFile (noms de fichier en minuscules), UserSam, SHA256, SHA1, MD5, RegistryEventType, EventName.
// Fragment propre à Sentinel : retiré de la variante Defender (les règles l'appellent dans des blocs @sentinel-only).
// Ne produit rien sans Sysmon installé et une configuration qui journalise les EventID demandés.
// @sentinel-only:begin
let _SysmonEventName = (id:int) {
    case(
        id == 1, "Processus créé",
        id == 2, "Date de création d'un fichier modifiée",
        id == 3, "Connexion réseau",
        id == 5, "Processus terminé",
        id == 6, "Pilote chargé",
        id == 7, "Image (DLL) chargée",
        id == 8, "Thread distant créé",
        id == 10, "Accès à un processus",
        id == 11, "Fichier créé",
        id == 12, "Clé de registre créée ou supprimée",
        id == 13, "Valeur de registre modifiée",
        id == 14, "Clé ou valeur de registre renommée",
        id == 15, "Flux de fichier créé (ADS, Mark of the Web)",
        id == 17, "Canal nommé créé",
        id == 18, "Canal nommé connecté",
        id == 22, "Requête DNS",
        id == 23, "Fichier supprimé (archivé)",
        id == 25, "Altération de processus",
        id == 26, "Fichier supprimé",
        id == 29, "Exécutable détecté",
        strcat("Sysmon ", tostring(id)))
};
let _Sysmon = (start:datetime, end:datetime, ids:dynamic, term:string) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        Event
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where Source == "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon"
        | where array_length(ids) == 0 or EventID in (ids)
        | where isempty(term) or EventData has term or Computer has term
        | extend _x = EventData
        | extend
            Image = extract(@'<Data Name="Image">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),

rules.name: Alertes et renseignement sur l'IP
rules.description: Alertes Sentinel et Defender XDR qui citent l'IP, et indicateurs de menace (ThreatIntelIndicators, format STIX) qui la contiennent. La table historique ThreatIntelligenceIndicator n'est plus alimentée depuis le 31 juillet 2025.

reading.decisive: Indicateur actif à confiance élevée, ou alerte déjà confirmée sur la même IP.
reading.context: Alertes anciennes ou indicateurs expirés.
reading.noise: IP de CDN ou d'hébergeurs mutualisés présentes dans des flux de renseignement génériques.

rules.query:
// [IP-P5] Alertes et renseignement sur l'IP — Pivot / Adresse IP
// sentinel-pivot-rules 0.2.0. Paramètres : {{VALUE}}, {{T0}}, {{BEFORE_MIN}}, {{AFTER_MIN}}
let Value = trim(@"\s", @"{{VALUE}}");
let T0 = coalesce(todatetime(@"{{T0}}"), now());
let Before = coalesce(tolong(@"{{BEFORE_MIN}}"), 43200) * 1m; // défaut : 30d
let After = coalesce(tolong(@"{{AFTER_MIN}}"), 1440) * 1m; // défaut : 1d
let StartTimestamp = T0 - Before;
let EndTimestamp = T0 + After;

union isfuzzy=true
(
    SecurityAlert
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTimestamp .. EndTimestamp)
    | where Entities has Value or CompromisedEntity == Value
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, AlertName, AlertSeverity, ProductName, CompromisedEntity, Status) by SystemAlertId
    | project TimeGenerated, Source = "SecurityAlert", Title = AlertName, Severity = AlertSeverity, Provider = ProductName,
        Detail = strcat(CompromisedEntity, " · ", Status), Reference = SystemAlertId
),
(
    AlertEvidence
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTimestamp .. EndTimestamp)
    | where RemoteIP == Value or LocalIP == Value
    | summarize arg_min(TimeGenerated, Title, Severity, ServiceSource, EntityType, EvidenceRole, DeviceName) by AlertId
    | project TimeGenerated, Source = "AlertEvidence", Title, Severity, Provider = ServiceSource,
        Detail = strcat(EntityType, " · ", EvidenceRole, " · ", DeviceName), Reference = AlertId
),
(
    ThreatIntelIndicators
    | where TimeGenerated between ((StartTimestamp - 60d) .. EndTimestamp)
    | where ObservableValue == Value or Pattern has Value
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Id
    | where not(IsDeleted) and not(Revoked)
    | project TimeGenerated, Source = "ThreatIntelIndicators", Title = tostring(Data.name),
        Severity = strcat("Confiance ", tostring(Confidence)), Provider = SourceSystem,
        Detail = strcat(Pattern, " · valide jusqu'au ", format_datetime(ValidUntil, "yyyy-MM-dd"), iff(IsActive, "", " · inactif")),
        Reference = Id
)
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

rules.name: Nature et rôle de l'IP
rules.description: Dit ce qu'est l'IP avant de pivoter dessus : privée ou publique, rôle connu (contrôleur de domaine détecté, NAT, proxy, VPN, scanner… déclarés dans la watchlist EasyPivotRoles, plages CIDR comprises), machines qui la portent (DeviceNetworkInfo, Heartbeat, DeviceInfo), et volume d'identités et de machines vues avec elle sur la fenêtre. Une IP vue avec beaucoup de comptes est signalée comme partagée : les pivots IP-P2, IP-S4 et IP-T3 y seront bruités.

reading.decisive: IP publique sans rôle connu, vue avec quelques comptes seulement, dont un succès inhabituel.
reading.context: IP partagée (NAT, proxy, VPN), à restreindre au compte ou à la machine plutôt qu'à l'IP.
reading.noise: IP d'un contrôleur de domaine ou d'un serveur d'infrastructure, présente dans presque tous les journaux.

// Événements de sécurité Windows normalisés, quelle que soit la table d'ingestion :
// Pour les SecurityEvent, on reparse les champs depuis le EventData XML si il y a des bugs, avec une regex (ajouté au moment du build)
// Paramètres : start, end (fenêtre), ids (liste d'EventID, vide = tous), term (pré-filtre texte, vide = aucun ;
// recherché dans le XML brut et dans les colonnes de compte, de machine, d'IP et de processus).
// Colonnes ajoutées pour ne pas confondre la machine qui journalise avec la machine utilisée :
// - TargetHost : machine réellement visée. 4769 : la machine du service demandé (ServiceName « FS01$ ») ; 4648 : TargetServerName ;
//   4768, 4771, 4776 : vide (simple validation d'identifiants, la cible n'est pas connue) ; sinon : Computer.
// - AuthAuthority : machine qui a validé les identifiants (DC, ou la machine elle-même pour un compte local en NTLM) pour
//   4768, 4769, 4771 et 4776 ; vide sinon.
// - SourceHost : poste d'origine déclaré (WorkstationName), à défaut l'IP source.
// - ObjectAccess : droits demandés sur un fichier, une clé ou un partage (lecture, écriture, suppression, permissions,
//   exécution) pour 4656, 4657, 4660, 4663, 4670, 5140 et 5145 (audit « Système de fichiers », « Registre », « Partage de
//   fichiers détaillé » : rien n'est produit sans stratégie d'audit et, pour les fichiers et le registre, sans SACL).
// Fragment propre à Sentinel : retiré de la variante Defender (les règles l'appellent dans des blocs @sentinel-only).
// @requires: win_names
// @sentinel-only:begin
let _WinSecurity = (start:datetime, end:datetime, ids:dynamic, term:string) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        SecurityEvent
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where array_length(ids) == 0 or EventID in (ids)
        | where isempty(term) or EventData has term or Computer has term or IpAddress has term or TargetUserName has term
            or SubjectUserName has term or WorkstationName has term or NewProcessName has term or ParentProcessName has term
            or TargetServerName has term
        | extend _x = tostring(EventData)
        | extend
            SubjectUserSid = coalesce(SubjectUserSid, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectUserSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectUserName = coalesce(SubjectUserName, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectUserName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectDomainName = coalesce(SubjectDomainName, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectDomainName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectLogonId = coalesce(SubjectLogonId, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectLogonId">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetUserSid = coalesce(TargetUserSid, TargetSid, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetUserSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetUserName = coalesce(TargetUserName, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetUserName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetDomainName = coalesce(TargetDomainName, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetDomainName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetLogonId = coalesce(TargetLogonId, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetLogonId">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            LogonType = coalesce(tostring(LogonType), extract(@'<Data Name="LogonType">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            LogonProcessName = coalesce(LogonProcessName, extract(@'<Data Name="LogonProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            AuthenticationPackageName = coalesce(AuthenticationPackageName, PackageName, extract(@'<Data Name="AuthenticationPackageName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="PackageName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            WorkstationName = coalesce(WorkstationName, Workstation, extract(@'<Data Name="WorkstationName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="Workstation">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            IpAddress = coalesce(IpAddress, ClientAddress, extract(@'<Data Name="IpAddress">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="ClientAddress">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            IpPort = coalesce(IpPort, extract(@'<Data Name="IpPort">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="ClientPort">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),

        | where isempty(upn) or UserPrincipalName =~ upn
        | extend _dev = DeviceDetail, _loc = LocationDetails, _st = Status
        | project TimeGenerated, SourceTable = "SigninLogs", SignInType = "Interactive", UserPrincipalName, UserId, AppDisplayName, AppId,
            ResourceDisplayName, ResultType, ResultDescription, FailureReason = tostring(_st.failureReason), IPAddress, Location,
            City = tostring(_loc.city), AutonomousSystemNumber, ClientAppUsed, UserAgent, DeviceName = tostring(_dev.displayName),
            DeviceId = tostring(_dev.deviceId), OperatingSystem = tostring(_dev.operatingSystem), Browser = tostring(_dev.browser),
            IsManaged = tostring(_dev.isManaged), IsCompliant = tostring(_dev.isCompliant), TrustType = tostring(_dev.trustType),
            ConditionalAccessStatus, AuthenticationRequirement, RiskLevelDuringSignIn, SessionId, CorrelationId
    ),
    (
        AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where isempty(ip) or IPAddress == ip
        | where isempty(upn) or UserPrincipalName =~ upn
        | extend _dev = parse_json(DeviceDetail), _loc = parse_json(LocationDetails), _st = parse_json(Status)
        | project TimeGenerated, SourceTable = "AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs", SignInType = "NonInteractive", UserPrincipalName, UserId,
            AppDisplayName, AppId, ResourceDisplayName, ResultType, ResultDescription, FailureReason = tostring(_st.failureReason),
            IPAddress, Location, City = tostring(_loc.city), AutonomousSystemNumber, ClientAppUsed, UserAgent,
            DeviceName = tostring(_dev.displayName), DeviceId = tostring(_dev.deviceId), OperatingSystem = tostring(_dev.operatingSystem),
            Browser = tostring(_dev.browser), IsManaged = tostring(_dev.isManaged), IsCompliant = tostring(_dev.isCompliant),
            TrustType = tostring(_dev.trustType), ConditionalAccessStatus, AuthenticationRequirement, RiskLevelDuringSignIn, SessionId, CorrelationId
    ),
    (
        EntraIdSignInEvents
        | where Timestamp between (start .. end)
        | extend SignInType = iff(LogonType contains "noninteractive", "NonInteractive", "Interactive")
        | where (SignInType == "Interactive" and not(_HasInteractive)) or (SignInType == "NonInteractive" and not(_HasNonInteractive))
        | where isempty(ip) or IPAddress == ip
        | where isempty(upn) or AccountUpn =~ upn
        | project TimeGenerated = Timestamp, SourceTable = "EntraIdSignInEvents", SignInType, UserPrincipalName = AccountUpn,
            UserId = AccountObjectId, AppDisplayName = Application, AppId = ApplicationId, ResourceDisplayName,
            ResultType = tostring(ErrorCode), ResultDescription = "", FailureReason = "", IPAddress, Location = Country, City,
            AutonomousSystemNumber = "", ClientAppUsed, UserAgent, DeviceName, DeviceId = EntraIdDeviceId, OperatingSystem = OSPlatform,
            Browser, IsManaged = tostring(IsManaged == 1), IsCompliant = tostring(IsCompliant == 1), TrustType = DeviceTrustType,
            ConditionalAccessStatus = case(ConditionalAccessStatus == 0, "success", ConditionalAccessStatus == 1, "failure",
                ConditionalAccessStatus == 2, "notApplied", tostring(ConditionalAccessStatus)),
            AuthenticationRequirement,
            RiskLevelDuringSignIn = case(RiskLevelDuringSignIn == 100, "high", RiskLevelDuringSignIn == 50, "medium",
                RiskLevelDuringSignIn == 10, "low", RiskLevelDuringSignIn == 0, "none", tostring(RiskLevelDuringSignIn)),
            SessionId, CorrelationId
    )
    | extend Succeeded = ResultType == "0"
};
// Connexions Entra ID des applications (service principals) et des identités managées, normalisées :
// - Sentinel : AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs et AADManagedIdentitySignInLogs ;
// - Defender XDR : EntraIdSpnSignInEvents (IsManagedIdentity distingue les deux), lue seulement pour le type que les tables
//   Sentinel ne fournissent pas sur la période (pas de doublon dans le portail unifié).
// Paramètres : start, end, app (AppId, ServicePrincipalId ou nom ; vide = toutes), ip (vide = toutes).
let _SpnSignins = (start:datetime, end:datetime, app:string, ip:string) {
    let _HasSpn = toscalar(union isfuzzy=true
        (AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs | where TimeGenerated between ((start - 1d) .. end) | take 1 | project Present = 1),
        (print Present = 0)
        | summarize max(Present)) == 1;
    let _HasMi = toscalar(union isfuzzy=true
        (AADManagedIdentitySignInLogs | where TimeGenerated between ((start - 1d) .. end) | take 1 | project Present = 1),
        (print Present = 0)
        | summarize max(Present)) == 1;
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where isempty(app) or AppId == app or ServicePrincipalId == app or ServicePrincipalName =~ app
        | where isempty(ip) or IPAddress == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, SourceTable = "AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs", SignInType = "Service principal", ServicePrincipalName,
            ServicePrincipalId, AppId, ResourceDisplayName, ResultType, IPAddress, Location, Credential = ClientCredentialType,
            AppOwnerTenantId, HomeTenantId = AADTenantId
    ),
    (
        AADManagedIdentitySignInLogs
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where isempty(app) or AppId == app or ServicePrincipalId == app or ServicePrincipalName =~ app
        | where isempty(ip) or IPAddress == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, SourceTable = "AADManagedIdentitySignInLogs", SignInType = "Identité managée", ServicePrincipalName,
            ServicePrincipalId, AppId, ResourceDisplayName, ResultType, IPAddress, Location, Credential = "Identité managée",
            AppOwnerTenantId, HomeTenantId = TenantId
    ),
    (
        EntraIdSpnSignInEvents
        | where Timestamp between (start .. end)
        | extend SignInType = iff(IsManagedIdentity, "Identité managée", "Service principal")
        | where (SignInType == "Service principal" and not(_HasSpn)) or (SignInType == "Identité managée" and not(_HasMi))
        | where isempty(app) or ApplicationId == app or ServicePrincipalId == app or ServicePrincipalName =~ app or Application =~ app
        | where isempty(ip) or IPAddress == ip
        | project TimeGenerated = Timestamp, SourceTable = "EntraIdSpnSignInEvents", SignInType, ServicePrincipalName = coalesce(ServicePrincipalName, Application),
            ServicePrincipalId, AppId = ApplicationId, ResourceDisplayName, ResultType = tostring(ErrorCode), IPAddress, Location = Country,
            Credential = iff(IsManagedIdentity, "Identité managée", iff(IsConfidentialClient, "Client confidentiel", "Client public")),
            AppOwnerTenantId = "", HomeTenantId = ResourceTenantId
    )
    | extend Succeeded = ResultType == "0"
    // Origine de l'application : éditeur Microsoft, application du tenant, ou application d'un autre tenant (multi-tenant tierce)
    | extend AppOrigin = case(AppOwnerTenantId in ("f8cdef31-a31e-4b4a-93e4-5f571e91255a", "72f988bf-86f1-41af-91ab-2d7cd011db47"), "Microsoft (first-party)",
        SignInType == "Identité managée", "Identité managée du tenant",
        isempty(AppOwnerTenantId), "",
        AppOwnerTenantId == HomeTenantId, "Application du tenant",
        "Application d'un autre tenant")
};
// Toutes les sources de journaux où apparaît une adresse IP, ramenées à des colonnes communes :
// TimeGenerated, Source, EventType (EventID, ActionType ou opération), Host, AuthBy, Account, Detail.
// - Host : machine concernée par l'événement (la cible quand l'IP est la source, la machine de l'IP quand elle est la cible),
//   jamais le contrôleur de domaine qui a seulement validé des identifiants.
// - AuthBy : contrôleur de domaine (ou machine locale) qui a validé les identifiants (4768, 4769, 4771, 4776, Defender for Identity).
// Sources : Entra ID (utilisateurs et applications), audit Entra ID, Microsoft Graph, Windows, Defender for Endpoint et
// Defender for Identity, Sysmon 3, accès aux partages (5140, 5145), Microsoft 365, Azure, pare-feu et proxy (CEF, Azure
// Firewall, ASIM), messagerie, Linux (Syslog).
// @requires: win_security, sysmon, signins, spn_signins
let _IpEvents = (start:datetime, end:datetime, ip:string) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        _Signins(start, end, ip, "")
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = strcat("Entra ID (", SignInType, ")"), EventType = iff(Succeeded, "Connexion réussie", strcat("Échec ", ResultType)),
            Host = DeviceName, AuthBy = "", Account = tolower(UserPrincipalName), Detail = AppDisplayName
    ),
    (
        _SpnSignins(start, end, "", ip)
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = strcat("Entra ID (", SignInType, ")"), EventType = iff(Succeeded, "Connexion réussie", strcat("Échec ", ResultType)),
            Host = "", AuthBy = "", Account = tolower(ServicePrincipalName), Detail = ResourceDisplayName
    ),
    (
        AuditLogs
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress) == ip or tostring(InitiatedBy.app.ipAddress) == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "AuditLogs", EventType = OperationName, Host = "", AuthBy = "",
            Account = tolower(coalesce(tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName), tostring(InitiatedBy.app.displayName))),
            Detail = tostring(TargetResources[0].displayName)
    ),
    (
        MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where IPAddress == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs", EventType = strcat(RequestMethod, " ", tostring(ResponseStatusCode)),
            Host = "", AuthBy = "", Account = coalesce(UserId, ServicePrincipalId),
            Detail = replace_regex(tostring(parse_url(RequestUri).Path), @"[0-9a-fA-F-]{36}", "{id}")
    ),
    (
        _WinSecurity(start, end, dynamic([]), ip)
        | where IpAddress == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = SourceTable, EventType = strcat(tostring(EventID), " ", EventName),
            Host = TargetHost, AuthBy = AuthAuthority, Account = coalesce(TargetSam, SubjectSam),
            Detail = case(EventID in (5140, 5145), strcat(ShareName, " ", RelativeTargetName, " · ", ObjectAccess), LogonTypeName)
    ),
    (
        _Sysmon(start, end, dynamic([3]), ip)
        | where DestinationIp == ip or SourceIp == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "Sysmon 3", EventType = iff(Initiated == "true", "Connexion sortante", "Connexion entrante"),
            Host = Computer, AuthBy = "", Account = UserSam,
            Detail = strcat(ProcessFile, " → ", DestinationIp, ":", DestinationPort, iff(isempty(DestinationHostname), "", strcat(" (", DestinationHostname, ")")))
    ),
    (
        DeviceNetworkEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where RemoteIP == ip or LocalIP == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "DeviceNetworkEvents", EventType = ActionType, Host = DeviceName, AuthBy = "",
            Account = tolower(InitiatingProcessAccountName), Detail = strcat(InitiatingProcessFileName, " → ", RemoteIP, ":", tostring(RemotePort))
    ),
    (
        DeviceLogonEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where RemoteIP == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "DeviceLogonEvents", EventType = ActionType, Host = DeviceName, AuthBy = "",
            Account = tolower(AccountName), Detail = LogonType
    ),
    (
        IdentityLogonEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where IPAddress == ip or DestinationIPAddress == ip
        // IP source : la machine concernée est la cible (le DC de destination n'a fait que valider) ; IP destination : la machine source
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "IdentityLogonEvents", EventType = ActionType,
            Host = iff(IPAddress == ip, TargetDeviceName, DeviceName),
            AuthBy = iff(IPAddress == ip, DestinationDeviceName, ""),
            Account = tolower(coalesce(AccountUpn, AccountName)), Detail = strcat(Application, " ", Protocol)
    ),
    (
        IdentityQueryEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where IPAddress == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "IdentityQueryEvents", EventType = strcat(ActionType, " ", QueryType), Host = DeviceName,
            AuthBy = DestinationDeviceName, Account = tolower(coalesce(AccountUpn, AccountName)), Detail = strcat(Protocol, " ", QueryTarget)
    ),
    (
        IdentityDirectoryEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where IPAddress == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "IdentityDirectoryEvents", EventType = ActionType, Host = coalesce(TargetDeviceName, DeviceName),
            AuthBy = DestinationDeviceName, Account = tolower(coalesce(AccountUpn, AccountName)), Detail = strcat(Application, " ", Protocol)
    ),
    (
        ASimAuthenticationEventLogs
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where SrcIpAddr == ip or TargetIpAddr == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = strcat("ASimAuthenticationEventLogs (", EventProduct, ")"), EventType = strcat(EventType, " ", EventResult),
            Host = iff(SrcIpAddr == ip, coalesce(TargetHostname, DvcHostname), SrcHostname), AuthBy = "",
            Account = tolower(TargetUsername), Detail = strcat(LogonProtocol, " ", LogonMethod)
    ),
    (
        CloudAppEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where IPAddress == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "CloudAppEvents", EventType = ActionType, Host = "", AuthBy = "",
            Account = tolower(coalesce(tostring(RawEventData.UserId), AccountDisplayName)), Detail = Application
    ),
    (
        OfficeActivity
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where ClientIP has ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "OfficeActivity", EventType = Operation, Host = "", AuthBy = "",
            Account = tolower(UserId), Detail = OfficeWorkload
    ),
    (
        AzureActivity
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where CallerIpAddress == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "AzureActivity", EventType = OperationNameValue, Host = "", AuthBy = "",
            Account = tolower(Caller), Detail = ResourceGroup
    ),
    (
        CommonSecurityLog
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where SourceIP == ip or DestinationIP == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = strcat("CommonSecurityLog (", DeviceVendor, ")"), EventType = coalesce(DeviceAction, Activity),
            Host = iff(SourceIP == ip, DestinationHostName, SourceHostName), AuthBy = "",
            Account = tolower(coalesce(SourceUserName, DestinationUserName)), Detail = strcat(SourceIP, " → ", DestinationIP, ":", tostring(DestinationPort))
    ),
    (
        ASimNetworkSessionLogs
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where SrcIpAddr == ip or DstIpAddr == ip or SrcNatIpAddr == ip or DstNatIpAddr == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = strcat("ASimNetworkSessionLogs (", EventProduct, ")"), EventType = coalesce(DvcAction, EventResult),
            Host = iff(DstIpAddr == ip or DstNatIpAddr == ip, SrcHostname, DstHostname), AuthBy = "", Account = tolower(SrcUsername),
            Detail = strcat(SrcIpAddr, " → ", DstIpAddr, ":", tostring(DstPortNumber))
    ),
    (
        ASimWebSessionLogs
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where SrcIpAddr == ip or DstIpAddr == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = strcat("ASimWebSessionLogs (", EventProduct, ")"), EventType = coalesce(DvcAction, EventResult),
            Host = SrcHostname, AuthBy = "", Account = tolower(SrcUsername), Detail = Url
    ),
    (
        AZFWNetworkRule
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where SourceIp == ip or DestinationIp == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "AZFWNetworkRule", EventType = Action, Host = "", AuthBy = "", Account = "",
            Detail = strcat(SourceIp, " → ", DestinationIp, ":", tostring(DestinationPort), " ", Protocol)
    ),
    (
        AZFWApplicationRule
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where SourceIp == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "AZFWApplicationRule", EventType = Action, Host = "", AuthBy = "", Account = "",
            Detail = coalesce(TargetUrl, Fqdn)
    ),
    (
        EmailEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where SenderIPv4 == ip or SenderIPv6 == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "EmailEvents", EventType = DeliveryAction, Host = "", AuthBy = "",
            Account = tolower(SenderFromAddress), Detail = Subject
    ),
    (
        UrlClickEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where IPAddress == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "UrlClickEvents", EventType = ActionType, Host = "", AuthBy = "",
            Account = tolower(AccountUpn), Detail = Url
    ),
    (
        Syslog
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where SyslogMessage has ip or HostIP == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = strcat("Syslog (", ProcessName, ")"), EventType = SeverityLevel, Host = Computer, AuthBy = "",
            Account = tolower(extract(@"(?:Accepted|Failed) \S+ for (?:invalid user )?(\S+) from", 1, SyslogMessage)),
            Detail = substring(SyslogMessage, 0, 300)
    )
    | extend Host = tolower(Host), AuthBy = tolower(AuthBy)
};
// Rôles des entités (machines, IP, comptes) : distingue « où l'événement est journalisé » de « où l'entité est utilisée »
// et signale les entités qui faussent un pivot (contrôleur de domaine, NAT, proxy, compte de service…).
// Trois sources, combinées :
// 1. détection automatique des contrôleurs de domaine (DC) : émetteurs de 4768 (seul un KDC en produit), cibles LDAP vues par
//    Defender for Identity, machines qui acceptent des connexions Kerberos (port 88) selon Defender for Endpoint ;
// 2. watchlist Sentinel « EasyPivotRoles » (colonnes Entity, Type, Role, Note), modèle dans watchlists/EasyPivotRoles.csv ;
// 3. comptes : IdentityInfo (rôles Entra ID, groupes AD privilégiés, compte de service, étiquettes Defender for Identity)
//    et noms réservés (compte machine, compte système, krbtgt, synchronisation Entra Connect).
// Chaque fonction prend l'instant de référence `at` et regarde la journée qui précède (14 jours pour IdentityInfo).
// Les blocs « @sentinel-only » sont retirés de la variante Defender XDR (tables absentes de Defender).
//
// _HostKey(h) : nom court en minuscules (FQDN, NetBIOS, compte machine « PC01$ » → « pc01 ») ; vide pour une adresse IP.
let _HostKey = (h:string) {
    iff(isnotnull(parse_ipv4(h)) or h contains ":", "", tolower(tostring(split(trim_end(@"\$", trim(@"[\s\\]+", h)), ".")[0])))
};
// _SamOf(a) : nom SAM d'un compte, depuis « DOMAINE\nom », « nom@domaine » ou « nom ».
let _SamOf = (a:string) { tolower(tostring(split(tostring(split(a, "@")[0]), @"\")[-1])) };
// _Labeled(nom, rôle) : « dc01 [DC] », pour annoter les listes (make_set) sans ajouter de colonne.
let _Labeled = (name:string, role:string) { iff(isempty(role), name, strcat(name, " [", role, "]")) };
// _JoinRoles(a, b) : concatène deux libellés de rôle en ignorant les vides.
let _JoinRoles = (a:string, b:string) { strcat_array(set_difference(pack_array(a, b), dynamic([""])), ", ") };
// _AccountKind(nom SAM) : catégorie déduite du nom seul.
let _AccountKind = (sam:string) {
    case(
        sam endswith "$", "Compte machine",
        sam in ("system", "local system", "local service", "network service", "anonymous logon", "iusr", "-")
            or sam startswith "dwm-" or sam startswith "umfd-", "Compte système",
        sam == "krbtgt", "Compte KDC (krbtgt)",
        sam startswith "msol_" or sam startswith "sync_" or sam startswith "aad_" or sam startswith "adtoaadsyncserviceaccount",
            "Synchronisation Entra Connect",
        sam in ("administrator", "administrateur"), "Administrateur intégré",
        "")
};
// _DcEvidence(at) : machines (et IP) qui se comportent comme des contrôleurs de domaine.
let _DcEvidence = (at:datetime) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        datatable(Machine:string, Ip:string, Basis:string)[]
    ),
    // @sentinel-only:begin
    (
        SecurityEvent
        | where TimeGenerated between ((at - 1d) .. at)
        | where EventID == 4768
        | summarize by Computer
        | project Machine = Computer, Ip = "", Basis = "Émet des 4768 (KDC)"
    ),
    (
        WindowsEvent
        | where TimeGenerated between ((at - 1d) .. at)
        | where Provider == "Microsoft-Windows-Security-Auditing" and EventID == 4768
        | summarize by Computer
        | project Machine = Computer, Ip = "", Basis = "Émet des 4768 (KDC)"
    ),
    // @sentinel-only:end
    (
        IdentityQueryEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between ((at - 1d) .. at)
        | where Protocol =~ "Ldap" and isnotempty(DestinationDeviceName)
        | summarize by DestinationDeviceName, DestinationIPAddress
        | project Machine = DestinationDeviceName, Ip = DestinationIPAddress, Basis = "Cible LDAP (Defender for Identity)"
    ),
    (
        DeviceNetworkEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between ((at - 1d) .. at)
        | where LocalPort == 88 and ActionType in ("InboundConnectionAccepted", "ListeningConnectionCreated")
        | summarize by DeviceName, LocalIP
        | project Machine = DeviceName, Ip = LocalIP, Basis = "Accepte Kerberos sur le port 88 (Defender for Endpoint)"
    )
};
// _MachineRoles(at) : MachineKey (nom court), MachineRole (« DC, Serveur de fichiers »), MachineRoleBasis (preuves).
let _MachineRoles = (at:datetime) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        datatable(MachineKey:string, Role:string, Basis:string)[]
    ),
    (
        _DcEvidence(at)
        | project MachineKey = _HostKey(Machine), Role = "DC", Basis
    ),
    (
        Watchlist
        | where WatchlistAlias =~ "EasyPivotRoles" and _DTItemType == "watchlist-item"
        | summarize arg_max(_DTTimestamp, _DTItemStatus, WatchlistItem) by _DTItemId
        | where _DTItemStatus != "Deleted"
        | where tolower(tostring(WatchlistItem.Type)) in ("machine", "host", "device", "serveur", "poste")
        | project MachineKey = _HostKey(tostring(WatchlistItem.Entity)), Role = tostring(WatchlistItem.Role),
            Basis = strcat("Watchlist EasyPivotRoles ", tostring(WatchlistItem.Note))
    )
    | where isnotempty(MachineKey) and isnotempty(Role)
    | summarize MachineRoles = make_set(Role), MachineRoleBasis = make_set(Basis, 5) by MachineKey
    | project MachineKey, MachineRole = strcat_array(MachineRoles, ", "), MachineRoleBasis
};
// _IpRoles(at) : Ip (adresse exacte ou plage CIDR), IpRole, IpRoleBasis.
let _IpRoles = (at:datetime) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        datatable(Ip:string, Role:string, Basis:string)[]
    ),
    (
        _DcEvidence(at)
        | where isnotempty(Ip)
        | project Ip, Role = "DC", Basis
    ),
    (
        Watchlist
        | where WatchlistAlias =~ "EasyPivotRoles" and _DTItemType == "watchlist-item"
        | summarize arg_max(_DTTimestamp, _DTItemStatus, WatchlistItem) by _DTItemId
        | where _DTItemStatus != "Deleted"
        | where tolower(tostring(WatchlistItem.Type)) in ("ip", "plage", "cidr", "subnet", "réseau")
        | project Ip = trim(@"\s", tostring(WatchlistItem.Entity)), Role = tostring(WatchlistItem.Role),
            Basis = strcat("Watchlist EasyPivotRoles ", tostring(WatchlistItem.Note))
    )
    | where isnotempty(Ip) and isnotempty(Role)
    | summarize IpRoles = make_set(Role), IpRoleBasis = make_set(Basis, 5) by Ip
    | project Ip, IpRole = strcat_array(IpRoles, ", "), IpRoleBasis
};
// _IpRoleOf(ip, at) : rôles connus d'une adresse, y compris par appartenance à une plage CIDR de la watchlist.
let _IpRoleOf = (ip:string, at:datetime) {
    toscalar(_IpRoles(at)
        | where Ip == ip or (Ip has "/" and ipv4_is_in_range(ip, Ip))
        | summarize Roles = strcat_array(make_set(IpRole), ", "))
};
// _AccountRoles(at) : AccountKey (nom SAM ou UPN, en minuscules), AccountRole, AccountRoleBasis.
let _AccountRoles = (at:datetime) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        datatable(AccountKey:string, Role:string, Basis:string)[]
    ),
    (
        IdentityInfo
        | where TimeGenerated between ((at - 14d) .. at)
        | extend Sam = tolower(coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists("SAMAccountName", "")), AccountName)),
            Upn = tolower(coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists("AccountUPN", "")), tostring(column_ifexists("AccountUpn", "")))),
            EntraRoles = tostring(column_ifexists("AssignedRoles", dynamic([]))),
            Groups = tostring(column_ifexists("GroupMembership", dynamic([]))),
            IsSvc = tobool(column_ifexists("IsServiceAccount", false)),
            IdTags = tostring(column_ifexists("Tags", ""))
        | where isnotempty(Sam)
        | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, Upn, EntraRoles, Groups, IsSvc, IdTags) by Sam
        | extend Roles = pack_array(
            iff(EntraRoles in ("", "[]", "null"), "", "Rôle Entra ID attribué"),
            iff(Groups has_any ("Domain Admins", "Enterprise Admins", "Schema Admins", "Account Operators", "Backup Operators",
                    "Server Operators", "Admins du domaine", "Administrateurs de l'entreprise", "Administrateurs du schéma",
                    "Opérateurs de compte", "Opérateurs de sauvegarde", "Opérateurs de serveur"), "Groupe AD privilégié", ""),
            iff(IsSvc, "Compte de service", ""),
            iff(IdTags has_any ("Sensitive", "Sensible"), "Compte sensible", ""),
            iff(IdTags has "Honeytoken", "Compte leurre", ""))
        | mv-expand Role = Roles to typeof(string)
        | where isnotempty(Role)
        | mv-expand AccountKey = pack_array(Sam, Upn) to typeof(string)
        | project AccountKey, Role, Basis = "IdentityInfo"
    ),
    (
        Watchlist
        | where WatchlistAlias =~ "EasyPivotRoles" and _DTItemType == "watchlist-item"
        | summarize arg_max(_DTTimestamp, _DTItemStatus, WatchlistItem) by _DTItemId
        | where _DTItemStatus != "Deleted"
        | where tolower(tostring(WatchlistItem.Type)) in ("compte", "account", "user", "utilisateur")
        | extend Raw = tolower(trim(@"\s", tostring(WatchlistItem.Entity)))
        | mv-expand AccountKey = pack_array(Raw, _SamOf(Raw)) to typeof(string)
        | project AccountKey, Role = tostring(WatchlistItem.Role), Basis = strcat("Watchlist EasyPivotRoles ", tostring(WatchlistItem.Note))
    )
    | where isnotempty(AccountKey) and isnotempty(Role)
    | summarize AccountRoles = make_set(Role), AccountRoleBasis = make_set(Basis, 5) by AccountKey
    | project AccountKey, AccountRole = strcat_array(AccountRoles, ", "), AccountRoleBasis
};
let Kind = case(
    Value matches regex @"^(127\.|::1$)", "Bouclage",
    ipv4_is_private(Value), "Privée (RFC 1918)",
    Value matches regex @"^(169\.254\.|fe80:)", "Lien local",
    Value matches regex @"^(100\.(6[4-9]|[7-9]\d|1[01]\d|12[0-7])\.)", "Partagée opérateur (CGNAT)",
    Value matches regex @"^(fc|fd)", "Privée (IPv6 ULA)",
    "Publique");
let Owners = union isfuzzy=true
    (datatable(Machine:string, Basis:string)[]),
    (DeviceNetworkInfo | where TimeGenerated between ((StartTimestamp - 1d) .. EndTimestamp) | where IPAddresses has Value
        | summarize by Machine = tolower(DeviceName) | extend Basis = "Carte réseau (DeviceNetworkInfo)"),
    (Heartbeat | where TimeGenerated between ((StartTimestamp - 1d) .. EndTimestamp) | where ComputerIP == Value or ComputerPrivateIPs has Value
        | summarize by Machine = tolower(Computer) | extend Basis = "Agent Azure Monitor (Heartbeat)"),
    (DeviceInfo | where TimeGenerated between ((StartTimestamp - 1d) .. EndTimestamp) | where PublicIP == Value
        | summarize by Machine = tolower(DeviceName) | extend Basis = "IP publique de sortie (DeviceInfo)");
let Seen = _IpEvents(StartTimestamp, EndTimestamp, Value)
    | summarize Events = count(), Accounts = dcountif(Account, isnotempty(Account) and Account != "-"),
        Machines = dcountif(Host, isnotempty(Host)), Sources = make_set(Source, 30),
        FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated);
Seen
| extend Ip = Value, Kind, KnownRole = _IpRoleOf(Value, EndTimestamp),
    OwnerMachines = toscalar(Owners | summarize make_set(strcat(Machine, " (", Basis, ")"), 20)),
    OwnerCount = toscalar(Owners | summarize dcount(Machine))
| extend Assessment = case(
    isnotempty(KnownRole), strcat("Rôle connu : ", KnownRole, ". Les pivots sur cette IP ramènent son trafic d'infrastructure."),
    OwnerCount > 3, "Portée par plusieurs machines (NAT, VPN, IP réattribuée) : pivoter sur la machine plutôt que sur l'IP.",
    Accounts > 20, "Vue avec de nombreux comptes : IP partagée probable (NAT, proxy, VPN, Citrix).",
    Events == 0, "Aucun événement sur la fenêtre : élargir la fenêtre ou vérifier la couverture (IP-S0).",
    "Pas de rôle connu ni de signe de partage.")
| project Ip, Kind, KnownRole, Assessment, OwnerMachines, Accounts, Machines, Events, FirstSeen, LastSeen, Sources

rules.name: Chaîne d'authentification Windows depuis l'IP
rules.description: Enchaînement des événements d'authentification Windows liés à l'IP : 4625 (échec), 4624 (succès), 4648 (identifiants explicites), 4768 et 4769 (Kerberos), 4771, 4776 (NTLM), puis, pour chaque session ouverte, les 4672 (privilèges), 4688 (processus lancés dans la session) et 4634 ou 4647 (fermeture), rattachés par l'identifiant de session sur la même machine. Couvre SecurityEvent et WindowsEvent, y compris quand les colonnes ne sont remplies que dans le XML brut. LoggedOn est la machine qui a journalisé l'événement, Target la machine réellement visée (service demandé pour un 4769, serveur cible pour un 4648) et ValidatedBy le contrôleur de domaine qui a validé les identifiants ; le rôle connu de LoggedOn est indiqué (LoggedOnRole).

reading.decisive: Série de 4625 puis 4624 de type 3 ou 10, suivie d'un 4672 et de 4688 dans la même session.
reading.context: Ticket 4769 demandé avec un chiffrement RC4 (0x17) vers un compte de service (Kerberoasting).
reading.noise: Ouvertures de type 3 répétées par des serveurs de fichiers, d'impression ou de supervision.

rules.query:
// [IP-T1] Chaîne d'authentification Windows depuis l'IP — Timeline / Adresse IP
// sentinel-pivot-rules 0.2.0. Paramètres : {{VALUE}}, {{T0}}, {{BEFORE_MIN}}, {{AFTER_MIN}}
let Value = trim(@"\s", @"{{VALUE}}");
let T0 = coalesce(todatetime(@"{{T0}}"), now());
let Before = coalesce(tolong(@"{{BEFORE_MIN}}"), 30) * 1m; // défaut : 30m
let After = coalesce(tolong(@"{{AFTER_MIN}}"), 30) * 1m; // défaut : 30m
let StartTimestamp = T0 - Before;
let EndTimestamp = T0 + After;

let _WinEventName = (id:int) {
    case(
        id == 4624, "Ouverture de session réussie",
        id == 4625, "Échec d'ouverture de session",
        id == 4634, "Fermeture de session",
        id == 4647, "Déconnexion initiée par l'utilisateur",
        id == 4648, "Ouverture avec identifiants explicites",
        id == 4656, "Handle demandé sur un objet",
        id == 4657, "Valeur de registre modifiée",
        id == 4658, "Handle fermé",
        id == 4660, "Objet supprimé",
        id == 4663, "Accès à un objet",
        id == 4670, "Permissions d'un objet modifiées",
        id == 4672, "Privilèges spéciaux attribués",
        id == 4688, "Création de processus",
        id == 4697, "Service installé",
        id == 4698, "Tâche planifiée créée",
        id == 4702, "Tâche planifiée modifiée",
        id == 4720, "Compte utilisateur créé",
        id == 4722, "Compte utilisateur activé",
        id == 4724, "Réinitialisation de mot de passe",
        id == 4728, "Membre ajouté à un groupe global de sécurité",
        id == 4732, "Membre ajouté à un groupe local de sécurité",
        id == 4740, "Compte verrouillé",
        id == 4756, "Membre ajouté à un groupe universel de sécurité",
        id == 4768, "Ticket Kerberos TGT demandé",
        id == 4769, "Ticket de service Kerberos demandé",
        id == 4771, "Échec de pré-authentification Kerberos",
        id == 4776, "Validation d'identifiants NTLM",
        id == 4778, "Session RDP reconnectée",
        id == 4779, "Session RDP déconnectée",
        id == 5140, "Accès à un partage réseau",
        id == 5145, "Contrôle d'accès à un objet de partage",
        strcat("EventID ", tostring(id)))
};
let _LogonTypeName = (t:string) {
    case(
        t == "2", "Interactive",
        t == "3", "Network",
        t == "4", "Batch",
        t == "5", "Service",
        t == "7", "Unlock",
        t == "8", "NetworkCleartext",
        t == "9", "NewCredentials",
        t == "10", "RemoteInteractive",
        t == "11", "CachedInteractive",
        t)
};
// Événements de sécurité Windows normalisés, quelle que soit la table d'ingestion :
// Pour les SecurityEvent, on reparse les champs depuis le EventData XML si il y a des bugs, avec une regex (ajouté au moment du build)
// Paramètres : start, end (fenêtre), ids (liste d'EventID, vide = tous), term (pré-filtre texte, vide = aucun ;
// recherché dans le XML brut et dans les colonnes de compte, de machine, d'IP et de processus).
// Colonnes ajoutées pour ne pas confondre la machine qui journalise avec la machine utilisée :
// - TargetHost : machine réellement visée. 4769 : la machine du service demandé (ServiceName « FS01$ ») ; 4648 : TargetServerName ;
//   4768, 4771, 4776 : vide (simple validation d'identifiants, la cible n'est pas connue) ; sinon : Computer.
// - AuthAuthority : machine qui a validé les identifiants (DC, ou la machine elle-même pour un compte local en NTLM) pour
//   4768, 4769, 4771 et 4776 ; vide sinon.
// - SourceHost : poste d'origine déclaré (WorkstationName), à défaut l'IP source.
// - ObjectAccess : droits demandés sur un fichier, une clé ou un partage (lecture, écriture, suppression, permissions,
//   exécution) pour 4656, 4657, 4660, 4663, 4670, 5140 et 5145 (audit « Système de fichiers », « Registre », « Partage de
//   fichiers détaillé » : rien n'est produit sans stratégie d'audit et, pour les fichiers et le registre, sans SACL).
// Fragment propre à Sentinel : retiré de la variante Defender (les règles l'appellent dans des blocs @sentinel-only).
// @requires: win_names
// @sentinel-only:begin
let _WinSecurity = (start:datetime, end:datetime, ids:dynamic, term:string) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        SecurityEvent
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where array_length(ids) == 0 or EventID in (ids)
        | where isempty(term) or EventData has term or Computer has term or IpAddress has term or TargetUserName has term
            or SubjectUserName has term or WorkstationName has term or NewProcessName has term or ParentProcessName has term
            or TargetServerName has term
        | extend _x = tostring(EventData)
        | extend
            SubjectUserSid = coalesce(SubjectUserSid, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectUserSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectUserName = coalesce(SubjectUserName, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectUserName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectDomainName = coalesce(SubjectDomainName, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectDomainName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectLogonId = coalesce(SubjectLogonId, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectLogonId">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetUserSid = coalesce(TargetUserSid, TargetSid, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetUserSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetUserName = coalesce(TargetUserName, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetUserName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetDomainName = coalesce(TargetDomainName, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetDomainName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetLogonId = coalesce(TargetLogonId, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetLogonId">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            LogonType = coalesce(tostring(LogonType), extract(@'<Data Name="LogonType">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            LogonProcessName = coalesce(LogonProcessName, extract(@'<Data Name="LogonProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            AuthenticationPackageName = coalesce(AuthenticationPackageName, PackageName, extract(@'<Data Name="AuthenticationPackageName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="PackageName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            WorkstationName = coalesce(WorkstationName, Workstation, extract(@'<Data Name="WorkstationName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="Workstation">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            IpAddress = coalesce(IpAddress, ClientAddress, extract(@'<Data Name="IpAddress">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="ClientAddress">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            IpPort = coalesce(IpPort, extract(@'<Data Name="IpPort">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="ClientPort">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ProcessName = coalesce(ProcessName, extract(@'<Data Name="ProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ElevatedToken = coalesce(ElevatedToken, extract(@'<Data Name="ElevatedToken">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            Status = coalesce(Status, extract(@'<Data Name="Status">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubStatus = coalesce(SubStatus, extract(@'<Data Name="SubStatus">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ServiceName = coalesce(ServiceName, extract(@'<Data Name="ServiceName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TicketEncryptionType = extract(@'<Data Name="TicketEncryptionType">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            TicketOptions = extract(@'<Data Name="TicketOptions">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            TargetServerName = coalesce(TargetServerName, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetServerName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            NewProcessName = coalesce(NewProcessName, extract(@'<Data Name="NewProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ParentProcessName = coalesce(ParentProcessName, extract(@'<Data Name="ParentProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            CommandLine = coalesce(CommandLine, extract(@'<Data Name="CommandLine">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TaskName = extract(@'<Data Name="TaskName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            TaskContent = coalesce(extract(@'<Data Name="TaskContent">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="TaskContentNew">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            MemberName = coalesce(MemberName, extract(@'<Data Name="MemberName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            MemberSid = coalesce(MemberSid, extract(@'<Data Name="MemberSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ServiceFileName = coalesce(ServiceFileName, extract(@'<Data Name="ServiceFileName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="ImagePath">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ShareName = coalesce(ShareName, extract(@'<Data Name="ShareName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            RelativeTargetName = coalesce(RelativeTargetName, extract(@'<Data Name="RelativeTargetName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ObjectName = coalesce(ObjectName, extract(@'<Data Name="ObjectName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            AccessMask = coalesce(AccessMask, extract(@'<Data Name="AccessMask">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            AccessList = extract(@'<Data Name="AccessList">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            ObjectType = coalesce(ObjectType, extract(@'<Data Name="ObjectType">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            HandleId = coalesce(HandleId, extract(@'<Data Name="HandleId">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ObjectValueName = coalesce(ObjectValueName, extract(@'<Data Name="ObjectValueName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ShareLocalPath = coalesce(ShareLocalPath, extract(@'<Data Name="ShareLocalPath">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            PrivilegeList = coalesce(PrivilegeList, extract(@'<Data Name="PrivilegeList">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x))
        | extend SourceTable = "SecurityEvent"
    ),
    (
        WindowsEvent
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where Provider == "Microsoft-Windows-Security-Auditing"
        | where array_length(ids) == 0 or EventID in (ids)
        | where isempty(term) or tostring(EventData) has term or RawEventData has term or Computer has term
        | extend _x = tostring(RawEventData)
        | extend
            SubjectUserSid = coalesce(tostring(EventData.SubjectUserSid), extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectUserSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectUserName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.SubjectUserName), extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectUserName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectDomainName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.SubjectDomainName), extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectDomainName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectLogonId = coalesce(tostring(EventData.SubjectLogonId), extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectLogonId">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetUserSid = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TargetUserSid), tostring(EventData.TargetSid), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetUserSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetUserName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TargetUserName), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetUserName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetDomainName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TargetDomainName), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetDomainName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetLogonId = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TargetLogonId), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetLogonId">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            LogonType = coalesce(tostring(EventData.LogonType), extract(@'<Data Name="LogonType">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            LogonProcessName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.LogonProcessName), extract(@'<Data Name="LogonProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            AuthenticationPackageName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.AuthenticationPackageName), tostring(EventData.PackageName), extract(@'<Data Name="AuthenticationPackageName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="PackageName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            WorkstationName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.WorkstationName), tostring(EventData.Workstation), extract(@'<Data Name="WorkstationName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="Workstation">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            IpAddress = coalesce(tostring(EventData.IpAddress), tostring(EventData.ClientAddress), extract(@'<Data Name="IpAddress">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="ClientAddress">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            IpPort = coalesce(tostring(EventData.IpPort), tostring(EventData.ClientPort), extract(@'<Data Name="IpPort">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="ClientPort">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ProcessName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ProcessName), extract(@'<Data Name="ProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ElevatedToken = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ElevatedToken), extract(@'<Data Name="ElevatedToken">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            Status = coalesce(tostring(EventData.Status), extract(@'<Data Name="Status">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubStatus = coalesce(tostring(EventData.SubStatus), extract(@'<Data Name="SubStatus">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ServiceName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ServiceName), extract(@'<Data Name="ServiceName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TicketEncryptionType = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TicketEncryptionType), extract(@'<Data Name="TicketEncryptionType">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TicketOptions = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TicketOptions), extract(@'<Data Name="TicketOptions">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetServerName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TargetServerName), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetServerName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            NewProcessName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.NewProcessName), extract(@'<Data Name="NewProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ParentProcessName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ParentProcessName), extract(@'<Data Name="ParentProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            CommandLine = coalesce(tostring(EventData.CommandLine), extract(@'<Data Name="CommandLine">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TaskName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TaskName), extract(@'<Data Name="TaskName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TaskContent = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TaskContent), tostring(EventData.TaskContentNew), extract(@'<Data Name="TaskContent">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="TaskContentNew">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            MemberName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.MemberName), extract(@'<Data Name="MemberName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            MemberSid = coalesce(tostring(EventData.MemberSid), extract(@'<Data Name="MemberSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ServiceFileName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ServiceFileName), tostring(EventData.ImagePath), extract(@'<Data Name="ServiceFileName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="ImagePath">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ShareName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ShareName), extract(@'<Data Name="ShareName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            RelativeTargetName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.RelativeTargetName), extract(@'<Data Name="RelativeTargetName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ObjectName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ObjectName), extract(@'<Data Name="ObjectName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            AccessMask = coalesce(tostring(EventData.AccessMask), extract(@'<Data Name="AccessMask">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            AccessList = coalesce(tostring(EventData.AccessList), extract(@'<Data Name="AccessList">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ObjectType = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ObjectType), extract(@'<Data Name="ObjectType">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            HandleId = coalesce(tostring(EventData.HandleId), extract(@'<Data Name="HandleId">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ObjectValueName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ObjectValueName), extract(@'<Data Name="ObjectValueName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ShareLocalPath = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ShareLocalPath), extract(@'<Data Name="ShareLocalPath">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            PrivilegeList = coalesce(tostring(EventData.PrivilegeList), extract(@'<Data Name="PrivilegeList">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x))
        | extend SourceTable = "WindowsEvent"
    )
    | extend IpAddress = iff(IpAddress == "-", "", trim_start(@"::ffff:", IpAddress))
    | extend WorkstationName = iff(WorkstationName == "-", "", trim_start(@"\\\\", WorkstationName))
    | extend TargetSam = tolower(tostring(split(TargetUserName, "@")[0])), SubjectSam = tolower(SubjectUserName)
    | extend EventName = _WinEventName(EventID), LogonTypeName = _LogonTypeName(LogonType)
    | extend _svcAccount = tolower(tostring(split(ServiceName, "@")[0]))
    | extend TargetHost = tolower(case(
            EventID == 4769 and _svcAccount endswith "$", trim_end(@"\$", _svcAccount),
